0.25rem\n  space-sm: 0.5rem\n  space-md: 1rem\n  space-lg: 1.25rem\n  space-xl: 1.5rem\n  space-xxl: 2rem\n---\n\n## Brand & Style\n\nThis design system defines an AI-powered screenshot utility that bridges media capture and calendar scheduling through a glass-tech interface. The visual language balances high-velocity utility with cinematic depth, transforming chaotic on-screen captures into structured temporal actions.\n\n### Design Movements & Tone\n- **Atmospheric Glassmorphism:** Heavy reliance on optical multi-layering, translucent surfaces, specularity, and frosted backdrop blurs (`20px` to `24px`). Surfaces mimic precision-milled optical glass panels suspended in a dark vacuum.\n- **Cinematic Futurism & Neon Precision:** Laser-like scanning beams, neon cyan tiles, and warm laser bursts provide targeted points of interactive energy without cluttering information density.\n- **Tone Matrix:** Focused, dependable, frictionless, and intelligent. The UI avoids playful cartoonishness and sterile monochrome minimalism, balancing engineered precision with responsive visual feedback.\n\n## Colors\n\nThe palette operates natively in Apple **Display P3** wide color space, with fallback to sRGB. The dark-first palette uses midnight navy (`#050816`) instead of pure black (`#000000`) to preserve dimensional separation between the canvas and layered glass surfaces.\n\n### Core Architecture\n- **Primary (`#7CFFEA`):** Derived from the vibrant cyan key tile. Used for active confirmations, high-confidence bounding tags, focused toggles, and primary CTA capsules. Text/icons on solid primary fills use `#07111F`.\n- **Secondary (`#5B7CFF`):** Vibrant indigo used for persistent navigation accents, active tab markers, and cool ambient backdrop undertones.\n- **Tertiary (`#FF4FB3`):** High-energy neon magenta that acts as the scan core and celebration hue. Paired with thermal orange (`#FF8A3D`) in dynamic scan beams.\n- **Neutral (`#050816`):** Deep oceanic navy canvas serving as the ground foundation across all primary screens.\n\n### Signature Gradients\n- **Scan Beam Gradient:** `linear-gradient(90deg, #FF8A3D 0%, #FF4FB3 48%, #7B61FF 100%)` for OCR sweeping animations and processing bars.\n- **Brand Aurora Gradient:** `linear-gradient(135deg, #32C5FF 0%, #5B7CFF 30%, #9D4DFF 62%, #FF4FB3 82%, #FF8A3D 100%)` for hero milestone surfaces and primary action badges.\n\n### Color Rules & Hierarchy\n- Limit bright gradient sweeps and saturated glows to a single dominant focal point per viewport.\n- Never place raw `#F7F8FF` text directly over unclamped linear gradients; provide a translucent `#050816` or `rgba(18, 24, 52, 0.72)` glass barrier to preserve WCAG AA contrast.\n\n## Typography\n\nThe typographic hierarchy pairs the geometric personality of **Sora** with the neutral legibility of **Inter** (or Apple system **SF Pro** in native compilation).\n\n### Structural Roles\n- **Sora (Display & Metrics):** Applied across all structural anchors\u2014large screen headings, hero extraction stats, DateBadge calendar numerals, and uppercase metric tags. The tight geometric apertures provide technical authority.\n- **Inter / SF Pro (UI & Parsing Engine):** Applied to narrative event descriptions, interactive button labels, input fields, and timestamps.\n- **11px Overlines:** Strictly transformed to uppercase with positive letter tracking (`+0.04em`) to establish visual landmarks without pulling weight away from primary event titles.\n- **Input Scaling:** Standard body inputs are locked to a minimum `16px` to prevent viewport auto-zooming on mobile web and iOS Safari views.\n\n## Layout & Spacing\n\nLayouts follow a fluid, device-aware single-column structure for mobile viewports, expanding to a balanced multi-column modular grid on larger screens.\n\n### Spatial Rhythms\n- **Canvas Margins:** Mobile viewports strictly maintain `16px` (`margin: 1rem`) horizontal outer margins. iPads and large display formats expand to `24px` (`margin-tablet: 1.5rem`).\n- **Vertical Hierarchy:**\n  - Micro-element spacing (icon-to-text, chip gaps): `4px` to `8px` (`space-xs` to `space-sm`).\n  - Card internal padding: `20px` (`space-lg`) on mobile; `24px` (`space-xl`) on expanded cards.\n  - Inter-card flow: `16px` to `20px` (`space-md` to `space-lg`).\n  - Section-to-section separation: `32px` (`space-xxl`).\n- **iOS Safe Areas:** Pinned navigation components factor in hardware constraints: top headers offset by `54pt` for the Dynamic Island; bottom sheets and floating toolbars account for the `34pt` home indicator.\n\n## Elevation & Depth\n\nVisual hierarchy uses physical optics, layered refraction, and multi-tone rims rather than standard drop shadows.\n\n### The Optical Glass Model\n1. **Level 0 (Canvas):** Solid background in Deep Midnight Navy (`#050816`).\n2. **Level 1 (Subtle Inset / Inactive Track):** `rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05)` to `0.08` fill without blur for inactive pills and segmented controls.\n3. **Level 2 (Translucent Glass Paneling):** Applied to ActionCards, DateBadges, and bottom navigation bars. Fills use `rgba(18, 24, 52, 0.72)` supported by a `20px` to `24px` backdrop blur (`backdrop-filter: blur(20px)`).\n4. **Level 3 (Interactive Floating Sheets & Modals):** Foreground popovers and modal ScanSheets sit over a backdrop scrim (`rgba(4, 8, 22, 0.72)`) with a `30px` Gaussian blur.\n\n### Keyline Specularity & Border Rims\nEvery elevated glass panel uses a dual-edge lighting system:\n- **Base Perimeter Hairline:** A continuous 1px stroke using `rgba(173, 195, 255, 0.18)` provides structural definition against deep canvas backgrounds.\n- **Specular Top-Edge Rim:** An inner top highlight of 1px using `rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.22)` simulates an overhead key light refracting along the bevel of an optical glass sheet.\n- **Focused State Glows:** Selected states project an ambient radial wash of `0 0 20px rgba(124, 255, 234, 0.25)`.\n\n## Shapes\n\nThe shape system balances structural clarity with rounded glass ergonomics. Interactive components use higher radii to provide tactile touch targets.\n\n### Radius Assignments\n- **DateBadges & Confidence Chips:** `16px` radius (`rounded-lg`).\n- **Toggle Cards & Text Inputs:** `16px` to `20px` radius.\n- **ActionCards:** `24px` radius (`rounded-xl`).\n- **Hero Display Panels:** `26px` radius.\n- **CTA Action Buttons:** `28px` radius (producing continuous capsules at 56px heights).\n- **ScanSheets (Bottom Sheets):** `32px` radius along top leading corners.\n- **Confidence Pills & Status Badges:** `9999px` (full capsule).\n\n## Components\n\n### Buttons\n- **Primary CTA (\"Add to Calendar\"):** Capsule geometry (`28px` radius), height `56px`. Filled with solid Electric Cyan (`#7CFFEA`), using `#07111F` foreground in Sora/Inter 14px SemiBold. Emits a subtle cyan bloom shadow (`0 6px 20px rgba(124, 255, 234, 0.28)`). On touch down, scales to `0.985` over `0.16s`.\n- **Secondary Glass Button:** Translucent fill `rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08)`, 1px perimeter border `rgba(173, 195, 255, 0.18)`, top highlight `rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.22)`. Typography in `#F7F8FF`. Touch state increases background opacity to `0.14`.\n- **Destructive / Dismiss Button:** Low-profile ghost pill with transparent base and `#FF6B7A` text; active state reveals an ambient `rgba(255, 107, 122, 0.12)` fill.\n\n### ActionCard (Extracted Event Tile)\n- Translucent obsidian glass panel (`rgba(18, 24, 52, 0.72)`) with `24px` radius, `20px` internal padding, and `24px` backdrop blur.\n- Dual-edge lighting: 1px `rgba(173, 195, 255, 0.18)` perimeter border plus a 1px top highlight `rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.22)`.\n- **Internal Layout:** Horizontal leading lockup housing the 56x68px `DateBadge`, stacked middle block holding the event title (20px Sora SemiBold) and event time/location (14px Inter Regular in `#A8B0D4`), and trailing confidence pill.\n\n### DateBadge\n- Compact temporal anchor: `56px` wide by `68px` tall, `16px` corner radius.\n- Centered vertical stack: Month string in 11px Sora SemiBold uppercase (`#A8B0D4`), Day integer in 20px Sora Bold (`#F7F8FF`).\n- Border treatment matches the parent ActionCard. When reduced motion is preferred, shifts to a gentle `1.2s` opacity pulse.\n\n### Glass TabBar\n- Floating bottom dock: Height `84px` to `88px` (inclusive of safe area margins), surface `rgba(10, 14, 30, 0.72)` with `20px` material blur.\n- Structural boundary: 1px top hairline `rgba(173, 195, 255, 0.18)` without bottom/side borders.\n- **Active Route Indicator:** Rounded pill halo (`rgba(124, 255, 234, 0.12)`) anchoring the active icon, with the icon and label tinted in Electric Cyan (`#7CFFEA`). <!-- Ambient Atmospheric Backdrops -->
<div class="relative w-full flex flex-col items-center pt-space-md">
<!-- Hero Glass Shield Visual -->
<div class="relative w-full max-w-[320px] flex items-center justify-center my-space-sm py-space-sm">
<!-- Glow Halos -->
<div class="absolute w-44 h-44 rounded-full bg-accent-orange/15 blur-2xl -top-2 -left-2 pointer-events-none"></div>
<div class="absolute w-48 h-48 rounded-full bg-accent-purple/20 blur-3xl -bottom-3 -right-2 pointer-events-none"></div>
<div class="absolute w-36 h-36 rounded-full bg-primary-fixed/15 blur-2xl top-4 pointer-events-none"></div>
<!-- Elevated Multi-Layer Glass Badge Card -->
<div class="relative w-32 h-32 rounded-[28px] bg-card-glass backdrop-blur-xl flex flex-col items-center justify-center shadow-2xl">
<!-- Top keyline specular rim -->
<div class="absolute inset-x-0 top-0 h-px bg-glass-specular-top rounded-t-[28px]"></div>
<!-- Apple Calendar Replica Glass Tile -->
<div class="relative w-16 h-16 rounded-[18px] bg-surface-container flex flex-col overflow-hidden shadow-inner">
<div class="h-5 bg-gradient-to-r from-accent-orange to-status-warning flex items-center justify-center">
<span class="font-overline-confidence text-overline-confidence text-primary-foreground tracking-wider uppercase">APR</span>
</div>
<div class="flex-1 flex items-center justify-center bg-surface-container-highest">
<span class="font-display-title text-display-title text-foreground-primary">24</span>
</div>
</div>
<!-- Floating Lock / Warning Accent Shield -->
<div class="absolute -bottom-2 -right-2 w-10 h-10 rounded-full bg-surface-container-high backdrop-blur-md flex items-center justify-center shadow-lg">
<div class="w-8 h-8 rounded-full bg-status-warning/20 flex items-center justify-center">
<span class="material-symbols-outlined text-status-warning text-[18px]">lock_person</span>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<!-- Reassuring Message Header -->
<div class="text-center px-space-xs mt-space-sm mb-space-lg">
<div class="inline-flex items-center gap-space-xs px-space-md py-1 rounded-full bg-status-warning/10 mb-space-sm">
<span class="w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-status-warning animate-pulse"></span>
<span class="font-overline-confidence text-overline-confidence text-status-warning tracking-wider uppercase">Permission Paused</span>
</div>
<h1 class="font-headline-section text-headline-section text-foreground-primary tracking-tight">Calendar access is turned off</h1>
<p class="font-body-compact text-body-compact text-muted-foreground mt-space-sm leading-relaxed max-w-sm mx-auto">
        DateSnap needs access to write detected dates into your calendar. Don’t worry — your existing events remain completely private and are never read or stored.
      </p>
</div>
<!-- "What you can still do right now" Bento Glass Card -->
<div class="w-full rounded-[24px] bg-card-glass backdrop-blur-xl p-space-lg mb-space-md relative overflow-hidden shadow-lg">
<div class="absolute inset-x-0 top-0 h-px bg-glass-specular-top"></div>
<div class="flex items-center justify-between mb-space-md">
<div class="flex items-center gap-space-sm">
<span class="material-symbols-outlined text-primary-fixed text-[20px]">auto_awesome</span>
<h2 class="font-headline-card text-headline-card text-foreground-primary">What you can still do right now</h2>
</div>
<span class="font-caption text-caption text-primary-fixed bg-primary-fixed/10 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full">Available</span>
</div>
<!-- Feature Rows -->
<div class="flex flex-col gap-space-md">
<!-- Feature 1: Reminders -->
<div class="flex items-start gap-space-md p-space-sm rounded-xl bg-muted-surface/40 hover:bg-muted-surface/70 transition-colors">
<div class="w-8 h-8 rounded-full bg-status-success/15 flex items-center justify-center shrink-0 mt-0.5">
<span class="material-symbols-outlined text-status-success text-[18px]">check</span>
</div>
<div class="flex flex-col min-w-0">
<span class="font-body-strong text-body-compact text-foreground-primary">Apple Reminders Export</span>
<span class="font-caption text-caption text-muted-foreground mt-0.5 leading-snug">Export deadlines, tickets, and alerts directly to your native Reminders app without calendar access.</span>
</div>
</div>
<!-- Feature 2: Push Alerts -->
<div class="flex items-start gap-space-md p-space-sm rounded-xl bg-muted-surface/40 hover:bg-muted-surface/70 transition-colors">
<div class="w-8 h-8 rounded-full bg-status-success/15 flex items-center justify-center shrink-0 mt-0.5">
<span class="material-symbols-outlined text-status-success text-[18px]">check</span>
</div>
<div class="flex flex-col min-w-0">
<span class="font-body-strong text-body-compact text-foreground-primary">DateSnap Local Push Alerts</span>
<span class="font-caption text-caption text-muted-foreground mt-0.5 leading-snug">Receive intelligent on-device notifications &amp; pre-event sound cues for snapped screenshots.</span>
</div>
</div>
<!-- Feature 3: Manual & Draft Saving -->
<div class="flex items-start gap-space-md p-space-sm rounded-xl bg-muted-surface/40 hover:bg-muted-surface/70 transition-colors">
<div class="w-8 h-8 rounded-full bg-status-success/15 flex items-center justify-center shrink-0 mt-0.5">
<span class="material-symbols-outlined text-status-success text-[18px]">check</span>
</div>
<div class="flex flex-col min-w-0">
<span class="font-body-strong text-body-compact text-foreground-primary">Manual &amp; Draft Saving</span>
<span class="font-caption text-caption text-muted-foreground mt-0.5 leading-snug">Parse flyers, copy formatted event info with 1-tap, or save smart drafts to review whenever ready.</span>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<!-- Step-by-Step Enable Guide Glass Card -->
<div class="w-full rounded-[24px] bg-surface-container/60 backdrop-blur-xl p-space-lg mb-space-lg relative overflow-hidden shadow-md">
<div class="absolute inset-x-0 top-0 h-px bg-glass-specular-top"></div>
<div class="flex items-center gap-space-sm mb-space-md">
<div class="w-7 h-7 rounded-lg bg-secondary-container/40 flex items-center justify-center">
<span class="material-symbols-outlined text-secondary text-[16px]">settings</span>
</div>
<h3 class="font-headline-card text-body-strong text-foreground-primary">To enable Calendar syncing:</h3>
</div>
<ol class="flex flex-col gap-space-sm pl-1">
<li class="flex items-center gap-space-md text-on-surface">
<span class="w-6 h-6 rounded-full bg-muted-surface flex items-center justify-center font-overline-confidence text-overline-confidence text-foreground-primary shrink-0">1</span>
<span class="font-body-compact text-body-compact text-on-surface">
            Open iPhone <span class="font-body-strong text-foreground-primary">Settings</span>
</span>
</li>
<li class="flex items-center gap-space-md text-on-surface">
<span class="w-6 h-6 rounded-full bg-muted-surface flex items-center justify-center font-overline-confidence text-overline-confidence text-foreground-primary shrink-0">2</span>
<span class="font-body-compact text-body-compact text-on-surface">
            Scroll to find <span class="font-body-strong text-foreground-primary">DateSnap</span>
</span>
</li>
<li class="flex items-center gap-space-md text-on-surface">
<span class="w-6 h-6 rounded-full bg-muted-surface flex items-center justify-center font-overline-confidence text-overline-confidence text-foreground-primary shrink-0">3</span>
<span class="font-body-compact text-body-compact text-on-surface">
            Tap <span class="font-body-strong text-foreground-primary">Calendars</span> → select <span class="font-body-strong text-primary-fixed">Add Events Only</span> or <span class="font-body-strong text-foreground-primary">Full Access</span>
</span>
</li>
</ol>
</div>
<!-- Action Buttons Lockup -->
<div class="w-full flex flex-col gap-space-sm mb-space-lg">
<!-- Primary Action CTA -->
<button class="w-full h-14 rounded-full bg-primary-fixed text-primary-foreground font-body-strong text-body-compact flex items-center justify-center gap-space-xs shadow-[0_6px_20px_rgba(116,248,227,0.28)] hover:brightness-105 active:scale-[0.985] transition-all" id="open-settings-btn">
<span>Open iPhone Settings</span>
<span class="material-symbols-outlined text-[20px]">arrow_forward</span>
</button>
<!-- Secondary Glass Button -->
<button class="w-full h-14 rounded-full bg-muted-surface text-foreground-primary font-body-strong text-body-compact flex items-center justify-center gap-space-xs hover:bg-muted-surface/80 active:scale-[0.985] transition-all" id="continue-reminders-btn">
<span class="material-symbols-outlined text-[18px] text-muted-foreground">playlist_add_check</span>
<span>Continue with Reminders Only</span>
</button>
</div>
<!-- Security & Privacy Reassurance Footer -->
<div class="w-full flex items-center justify-center gap-space-xs py-space-sm px-space-md rounded-xl bg-surface-container-lowest/50 mb-space-lg text-center">
<span class="material-symbols-outlined text-status-success text-[16px] shrink-0">verified_user</span>
<p class="font-caption text-caption text-muted-foreground">
        DateSnap is 100% On-Device · Zero Cloud Sync · Private by Design
      </p>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<script>
  (function() {
    const settingsBtn = document.getElementById('open-settings-btn');
    const remindersBtn = document.getElementById('continue-reminders-btn');

    if (settingsBtn) {
      settingsBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
        settingsBtn.classList.add('scale-[0.97]');
        setTimeout(() => {
          settingsBtn.classList.remove('scale-[0.97]');
          // Deep link trigger emulation for native app layer
          console.log('[DateSnap] Opening iOS System Settings...');
        }, 150);
      });
    }

    if (remindersBtn) {
      remindersBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
        remindersBtn.classList.add('opacity-70');
        setTimeout(() => {
          remindersBtn.classList.remove('opacity-70');
          console.log('[DateSnap] Fallback to Reminders mode engaged.');
        }, 150);
      });
    }
  })();
</script></main></body></html>

      "styleGuidelines": "## Brand & Style\n\nThis design system defines an AI-powered screenshot utility that bridges media capture and calendar scheduling through a glass-tech interface. The visual language balances high-velocity utility with cinematic depth, transforming chaotic on-screen captures into structured temporal actions.\n\n### Design Movements & Tone\n- **Atmospheric Glassmorphism:** Heavy reliance on optical multi-layering, translucent surfaces, specularity, and frosted backdrop blurs (`20px` to `24px`). Surfaces mimic precision-milled optical glass panels suspended in a dark vacuum.\n- **Cinematic Futurism & Neon Precision:** Laser-like scanning beams, neon cyan tiles, and warm laser bursts provide targeted points of interactive energy without cluttering information density.\n- **Tone Matrix:** Focused, dependable, frictionless, and intelligent. The UI avoids playful cartoonishness and sterile monochrome minimalism, balancing engineered precision with responsive visual feedback.\n\n## Layout & Spacing\n\nLayouts follow a fluid, device-aware single-column structure for mobile viewports, expanding to a balanced multi-column modular grid on larger screens.\n\n### Spatial Rhythms\n- **Canvas Margins:** Mobile viewports strictly maintain `16px` (`margin: 1rem`) horizontal outer margins. iPads and large display formats expand to `24px` (`margin-tablet: 1.5rem`).\n- **Vertical Hierarchy:**\n  - Micro-element spacing (icon-to-text, chip gaps): `4px` to `8px` (`space-xs` to `space-sm`).\n  - Card internal padding: `20px` (`space-lg`) on mobile; `24px` (`space-xl`) on expanded cards.\n  - Inter-card flow: `16px` to `20px` (`space-md` to `space-lg`).\n  - Section-to-section separation: `32px` (`space-xxl`).\n- **iOS Safe Areas:** Pinned navigation components factor in hardware constraints: top headers offset by `54pt` for the Dynamic Island; bottom sheets and floating toolbars account for the `34pt` home indicator.\n\n## Elevation & Depth\n\nVisual hierarchy uses physical optics, layered refraction, and multi-tone rims rather than standard drop shadows.\n\n### The Optical Glass Model\n1. **Level 0 (Canvas):** Solid background in Deep Midnight Navy (`#050816`).\n2. **Level 1 (Subtle Inset / Inactive Track):** `rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05)` to `0.08` fill without blur for inactive pills and segmented controls.\n3. **Level 2 (Translucent Glass Paneling):** Applied to ActionCards, DateBadges, and bottom navigation bars. Fills use `rgba(18, 24, 52, 0.72)` supported by a `20px` to `24px` backdrop blur (`backdrop-filter: blur(20px)`).\n4. **Level 3 (Interactive Floating Sheets & Modals):** Foreground popovers and modal ScanSheets sit over a backdrop scrim (`rgba(4, 8, 22, 0.72)`) with a `30px` Gaussian blur.\n\n### Keyline Specularity & Border Rims\nEvery elevated glass panel uses a dual-edge lighting system:\n- **Base Perimeter Hairline:** A continuous 1px stroke using `rgba(173, 195, 255, 0.18)` provides structural definition against deep canvas backgrounds.\n- **Specular Top-Edge Rim:** An inner top highlight of 1px using `rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.22)` simulates an overhead key light refracting along the bevel of an optical glass sheet.\n- **Focused State Glows:** Selected states project an ambient radial wash of `0 0 20px rgba(124, 255, 234, 0.25)`.\n\n## Components\n\n### Buttons\n- **Primary CTA (\"Add to Calendar\"):** Capsule geometry (`28px` radius), height `56px`. Filled with solid Electric Cyan (`#7CFFEA`), using `#07111F` foreground in Sora/Inter 14px SemiBold. Emits a subtle cyan bloom shadow (`0 6px 20px rgba(124, 255, 234, 0.28)`). On touch down, scales to `0.985` over `0.16s`.\n- **Secondary Glass Button:** Translucent fill `rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08)`, 1px perimeter border `rgba(173, 195, 255, 0.18)`, top highlight `rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.22)`. Typography in `#F7F8FF`. Touch state increases background opacity to `0.14`.\n- **Destructive / Dismiss Button:** Low-profile ghost pill with transparent base and `#FF6B7A` text; active state reveals an ambient `rgba(255, 107, 122, 0.12)` fill.\n\n### ActionCard (Extracted Event Tile)\n- Translucent obsidian glass panel (`rgba(18, 24, 52, 0.72)`) with `24px` radius, `20px` internal padding, and `24px` backdrop blur.\n- Dual-edge lighting: 1px `rgba(173, 195, 255, 0.18)` perimeter border plus a 1px top highlight `rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.22)`.\n- **Internal Layout:** Horizontal leading lockup housing the 56x68px `DateBadge`, stacked middle block holding the event title (20px Sora SemiBold) and event time/location (14px Inter Regular in `#A8B0D4`), and trailing confidence pill.\n\n### DateBadge\n- Compact temporal anchor: `56px` wide by `68px` tall, `16px` corner radius.\n- Centered vertical stack: Month string in 11px Sora SemiBold uppercase (`#A8B0D4`), Day integer in 20px Sora Bold (`#F7F8FF`).\n- Border treatment matches the parent ActionCard. Active/selected state introduces a subtle cyan keyline rim glow.\n\n### Confidence Pills\n- Height: `24px`, capsule geometry (`9999px`), internal horizontal padding `10px`.\n- Layout: 12px semantic icon + 11px Sora SemiBold text tracking the confidence score.\n- **High (90%+):** Surface `rgba(70, 227, 154, 0.14)`, border `1px solid rgba(70, 227, 154, 0.40)`, text `#46E39A`.\n- **Medium (60%-89%):** Surface `rgba(255, 190, 85, 0.14)`, border `1px solid rgba(255, 190, 85, 0.40)`, text `#FFBE55`.\n- **Low (<60%):** Surface `rgba(255, 107, 122, 0.14)`, border `1px solid rgba(255, 107, 122, 0.40)`, text `#FF6B7A`.\n\n### ScanSheet & Beam Motion\n- Native bottom sheet container with `32px` top rounded corners and `30px` backdrop blur.\n- Pinned top edge highlighted by a continuous 1px specular line (`rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.22)`).\n- **The Scan Beam:** A horizontal 2px ray translating vertically over the screenshot capture:\n  - Fill: `linear-gradient(90deg, #FF8A3D 0%, #FF4FB3 48%, #7B61FF 100%)`.\n  - Ambient glow: `0 0 16px rgba(255, 79, 179, 0.65)`.\n  - Motion: `1.8s` linear infinite oscillation. When reduced motion is preferred, shifts to a gentle `1.2s` opacity pulse.\n\n### Glass TabBar\n- Floating bottom dock: Height `84px` to `88px` (inclusive of safe area margins), surface `rgba(10, 14, 30, 0.72)` with `20px` material blur.\n- Structural boundary: 1px top hairline `rgba(173, 195, 255, 0.18)` without bottom/side borders.\n- **Active Route Indicator:** Rounded pill halo (`rgba(124, 255, 234, 0.12)`) anchoring the active icon, with the icon and label tinted in Electric Cyan (`#7CFFEA`). Idle icons rest in `#A8B0D4` at `65%` opacity.\n\n### Form Inputs & Toggles\n- **Glass Text Input:** Height `52px`, `16px` radius, filled with `rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05)`. Active focus transitions border to `#7CFFEA` with a matching `0 0 12px rgba(124, 255, 234, 0.25)` halo.\n- **Toggle Card:** Min-height `84px`, `20px` radius. Features a glass row background. The active switch state displays an Electric Cyan thumb track accented by a subtle Neon Magenta halo edge.",

0.25rem\n  space-sm: 0.5rem\n  space-md: 1rem\n  space-lg: 1.25rem\n  space-xl: 1.5rem\n  space-xxl: 2rem\n---\n\n## Brand & Style\n\nThis design system defines an AI-powered screenshot utility that bridges media capture and calendar scheduling through a glass-tech interface. The visual language balances high-velocity utility with cinematic depth, transforming chaotic on-screen captures into structured temporal actions.\n\n### Design Movements & Tone\n- **Atmospheric Glassmorphism:** Heavy reliance on optical multi-layering, translucent surfaces, specularity, and frosted backdrop blurs (`20px` to `24px`). Surfaces mimic precision-milled optical glass panels suspended in a dark vacuum.\n- **Cinematic Futurism & Neon Precision:** Laser-like scanning beams, neon cyan tiles, and warm laser bursts provide targeted points of interactive energy without cluttering information density.\n- **Tone Matrix:** Focused, dependable, frictionless, and intelligent. The UI avoids playful cartoonishness and sterile monochrome minimalism, balancing engineered precision with responsive visual feedback.\n\n## Colors\n\nThe palette operates natively in Apple **Display P3** wide color space, with fallback to sRGB. The dark-first palette uses midnight navy (`#050816`) instead of pure black (`#000000`) to preserve dimensional separation between the canvas and layered glass surfaces.\n\n### Core Architecture\n- **Primary (`#7CFFEA`):** Derived from the vibrant cyan key tile. Used for active confirmations, high-confidence bounding tags, focused toggles, and primary CTA capsules. Text/icons on solid primary fills use `#07111F`.\n- **Secondary (`#5B7CFF`):** Vibrant indigo used for persistent navigation accents, active tab markers, and cool ambient backdrop undertones.\n- **Tertiary (`#FF4FB3`):** High-energy neon magenta that acts as the scan core and celebration hue. Paired with thermal orange (`#FF8A3D`) in dynamic scan beams.\n- **Neutral (`#050816`):** Deep oceanic navy canvas serving as the ground foundation across all primary screens.\n\n### Signature Gradients\n- **Scan Beam Gradient:** `linear-gradient(90deg, #FF8A3D 0%, #FF4FB3 48%, #7B61FF 100%)` for OCR sweeping animations and processing bars.\n- **Brand Aurora Gradient:** `linear-gradient(135deg, #32C5FF 0%, #5B7CFF 30%, #9D4DFF 62%, #FF4FB3 82%, #FF8A3D 100%)` for hero milestone surfaces and primary action badges.\n\n### Color Rules & Hierarchy\n- Limit bright gradient sweeps and saturated glows to a single dominant focal point per viewport.\n- Never place raw `#F7F8FF` text directly over unclamped linear gradients; provide a translucent `#050816` or `rgba(18, 24, 52, 0.72)` glass barrier to preserve WCAG AA contrast.\n\n## Typography\n\nThe typographic hierarchy pairs the geometric personality of **Sora** with the neutral legibility of **Inter** (or Apple system **SF Pro** in native compilation).\n\n### Structural Roles\n- **Sora (Display & Metrics):** Applied across all structural anchors\u2014large screen headings, hero extraction stats, DateBadge calendar numerals, and uppercase metric tags. The tight geometric apertures provide technical authority.\n- **Inter / SF Pro (UI & Parsing Engine):** Applied to narrative event descriptions, interactive button labels, input fields, and timestamps.\n- **11px Overlines:** Strictly transformed to uppercase with positive letter tracking (`+0.04em`) to establish visual landmarks without pulling weight away from primary event titles.\n- **Input Scaling:** Standard body inputs are locked to a minimum `16px` to prevent viewport auto-zooming on mobile web and iOS Safari views.\n\n## Layout & Spacing\n\nLayouts follow a fluid, device-aware single-column structure for mobile viewports, expanding to a balanced multi-column modular grid on larger screens.\n\n### Spatial Rhythms\n- **Canvas Margins:** Mobile viewports strictly maintain `16px` (`margin: 1rem`) horizontal outer margins. iPads and large display formats expand to `24px` (`margin-tablet: 1.5rem`).\n- **Vertical Hierarchy:**\n  - Micro-element spacing (icon-to-text, chip gaps): `4px` to `8px` (`space-xs` to `space-sm`).\n  - Card internal padding: `20px` (`space-lg`) on mobile; `24px` (`space-xl`) on expanded cards.\n  - Inter-card flow: `16px` to `20px` (`space-md` to `space-lg`).\n  - Section-to-section separation: `32px` (`space-xxl`).\n- **iOS Safe Areas:** Pinned navigation components factor in hardware constraints: top headers offset by `54pt` for the Dynamic Island; bottom sheets and floating toolbars account for the `34pt` home indicator.\n\n## Elevation & Depth\n\nVisual hierarchy uses physical optics, layered refraction, and multi-tone rims rather than standard drop shadows.\n\n### The Optical Glass Model\n1. **Level 0 (Canvas):** Solid background in Deep Midnight Navy (`#050816`).\n2. **Level 1 (Subtle Inset / Inactive Track):** `rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05)` to `0.08` fill without blur for inactive pills and segmented controls.\n3. **Level 2 (Translucent Glass Paneling):** Applied to ActionCards, DateBadges, and bottom navigation bars. Fills use `rgba(18, 24, 52, 0.72)` supported by a `20px` to `24px` backdrop blur (`backdrop-filter: blur(20px)`).\n4. **Level 3 (Interactive Floating Sheets & Modals):** Foreground popovers and modal ScanSheets sit over a backdrop scrim (`rgba(4, 8, 22, 0.72)`) with a `30px` Gaussian blur.\n\n### Keyline Specularity & Border Rims\nEvery elevated glass panel uses a dual-edge lighting system:\n- **Base Perimeter Hairline:** A continuous 1px stroke using `rgba(173, 195, 255, 0.18)` provides structural definition against deep canvas backgrounds.\n- **Specular Top-Edge Rim:** An inner top highlight of 1px using `rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.22)` simulates an overhead key light refracting along the bevel of an optical glass sheet.\n- **Focused State Glows:** Selected states project an ambient radial wash of `0 0 20px rgba(124, 255, 234, 0.25)`.\n\n## Shapes\n\nThe shape system balances structural clarity with rounded glass ergonomics. Interactive components use higher radii to provide tactile touch targets.\n\n### Radius Assignments\n- **DateBadges & Confidence Chips:** `16px` radius (`rounded-lg`).\n- **Toggle Cards & Text Inputs:** `16px` to `20px` radius.\n- **ActionCards:** `24px` radius (`rounded-xl`).\n- **Hero Display Panels:** `26px` radius.\n- **CTA Action Buttons:** `28px` radius (producing continuous capsules at 56px heights).\n- **ScanSheets (Bottom Sheets):** `32px` radius along top leading corners.\n- **Confidence Pills & Status Badges:** `9999px` (full capsule).\n\n## Components\n\n### Buttons\n- **Primary CTA (\"Add to Calendar\"):** Capsule geometry (`28px` radius), height `56px`. Filled with solid Electric Cyan (`#7CFFEA`), using `#07111F` foreground in Sora/Inter 14px SemiBold. Emits a subtle cyan bloom shadow (`0 6px 20px rgba(124, 255, 234, 0.28)`). On touch down, scales to `0.985` over `0.16s`.\n- **Secondary Glass Button:** Translucent fill `rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08)`, 1px perimeter border `rgba(173, 195, 255, 0.18)`, top highlight `rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.22)`. Typography in `#F7F8FF`. Touch state increases background opacity to `0.14`.\n- **Destructive / Dismiss Button:** Low-profile ghost pill with transparent base and `#FF6B7A` text; active state reveals an ambient `rgba(255, 107, 122, 0.12)` fill.\n\n### ActionCard (Extracted Event Tile)\n- Translucent obsidian glass panel (`rgba(18, 24, 52, 0.72)`) with `24px` radius, `20px` internal padding, and `24px` backdrop blur.\n- Dual-edge lighting: 1px `rgba(173, 195, 255, 0.18)` perimeter border plus a 1px top highlight `rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.22)`.\n- **Internal Layout:** Horizontal leading lockup housing the 56x68px `DateBadge`, stacked middle block holding the event title (20px Sora SemiBold) and event time/location (14px Inter Regular in `#A8B0D4`), and trailing confidence pill.\n\n### DateBadge\n- Compact temporal anchor: `56px` wide by `68px` tall, `16px` corner radius.\n- Centered vertical stack: Month string in 11px Sora SemiBold uppercase (`#A8B0D4`), Day integer in 20px Sora Bold (`#F7F8FF`).\n- Border treatment matches the parent ActionCard. Active/selected state introduces a subtle cyan keyline rim glow.\n\n### Confidence Pills\n- Height: `24px`, capsule geometry (`9999px`), internal horizontal padding `10px`.\n- Layout: 12px semantic icon + 11px Sora SemiBold text tracking the confidence score.\n- **High (90%+):** Surface `rgba(70, 227, 154, 0.14)`, border `1px solid rgba(70, 227, 154, 0.40)`, text `#46E39A`.\n- **Medium (60%-89%):** Surface `rgba(255, 190, 85, 0.14)`, border `1px solid rgba(255, 190, 85, 0.40)`, text `#FFBE55`.\n- **Low (<60%):** Surface `rgba(255, 107, 122, 0.14)`, border `1px solid rgba(255, 107, 122, 0.40)`, text `#FF6B7A`.\n\n### ScanSheet & Beam Motion\n- Native bottom sheet container with `32px` top rounded corners and `30px` backdrop blur.\n- Pinned top edge highlighted by a continuous 1px specular line (`rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.22)`).\n- **The Scan Beam:** A horizontal 2px ray translating vertically over the screenshot capture:\n  - Fill: `linear-gradient(90deg, #FF8A3D 0%, #FF4FB3 48%, #7B61FF 100%)`.\n  - Ambient glow: `0 0 16px rgba(255, 79, 179, 0.65)`.\n  - Motion: `1.8s` linear infinite oscillation. When reduced motion is preferred, shifts to a gentle `1.2s` opacity pulse.\n\n### Glass TabBar\n- Floating bottom dock: Height `84px` to `88px` (inclusive of safe area margins), surface `rgba(10, 14, 30, 0.72)` with `20px` material blur.\n- Structural boundary: 1px top hairline `rgba(173, 195, 255, 0.18)` without bottom/side borders.\n- **Active Route Indicator:** Rounded pill halo (`rgba(124, 255, 234, 0.12)`) anchoring the active icon, with the icon and label tinted in Electric Cyan (`#7CFFEA`). Idle icons rest in `#A8B0D4` at `65%` opacity.\n\n### Form Inputs & Toggles\n- **Glass Text Input:** Height `52px`, `16px` radius, filled with `rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05)`. Active focus transitions border to `#7CFFEA` with a matching `0 0 12px rgba(124, 255, 234, 0.25)` halo.\n- **Toggle Card:** Min-height `84px`, `20px` radius. Features a glass row background. The active switch state displays an Electric Cyan thumb track accented by a subtle Neon Magenta halo edge.",

            </div>

            </p>
</div>
</div>
<!-- Benefit 2 -->
<div class="flex items-start gap-space-sm">
<div class="w-8 h-8 rounded-lg bg-surface-container-high/80 flex-shrink-0 flex items-center justify-center mt-0.5 shadow-sm">
<span class="material-symbols-outlined text-accent-orange text-[18px]">camera_enhance</span>
</div>
<div class="min-w-0 flex-1">

            </div>
<p class="font-caption text-caption text-muted-foreground mt-0.5">

            </p>

</div>
</div>

</div>
<!-- Alternative 2 -->
<div class="flex items-start gap-space-sm">
<div class="w-8 h-8 rounded-lg bg-surface-container-high/60 flex-shrink-0 flex items-center justify-center mt-0.5">
<span class="material-symbols-outlined text-status-info text-[18px]">checklist</span>

</div>

<div class="bg-surface-container/50 rounded-xl p-space-md">
<div class="flex items-center gap-space-xs text-muted-foreground mb-space-xs">
<span class="material-symbols-outlined text-[16px]">tune</span>
<span class="font-label-chip text-label-chip uppercase tracking-wider text-muted-foreground">Quick Path</span>
</div>
<div class="flex items-center flex-wrap gap-space-xs font-caption text-caption text-on-surface-variant">
<span class="bg-surface-container-high px-space-xs py-0.5 rounded text-foreground-primary">Settings</span>
<span class="material-symbols-outlined text-[12px] text-muted-foreground">chevron_right</span>
<span class="bg-surface-container-high px-space-xs py-0.5 rounded text-foreground-primary">DateSnap</span>
<span class="material-symbols-outlined text-[12px] text-muted-foreground">chevron_right</span>
<span class="bg-surface-container-high px-space-xs py-0.5 rounded text-foreground-primary">Notifications</span>
<span class="material-symbols-outlined text-[12px] text-muted-foreground">chevron_right</span>
<span class="text-primary-fixed font-body-strong">Allow</span>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<!-- Action CTAs -->
<div class="flex flex-col gap-space-sm mt-space-xl pt-space-xs">
<!-- Primary CTA -->
<button class="w-full h-14 rounded-full bg-primary-fixed text-primary-foreground font-headline-card text-body-strong flex items-center justify-center gap-space-xs shadow-[0_6px_20px_rgba(124,255,234,0.28)] active:scale-[0.985] transition-all hover:bg-primary-fixed-dim cursor-pointer" id="btn-open-settings">
<span>Enable in Settings</span>
<span class="material-symbols-outlined text-[20px]">arrow_forward</span>
</button>
<!-- Secondary Action -->
<button class="w-full h-14 rounded-full bg-surface-container-high/60 backdrop-blur-xl text-foreground-primary font-headline-card text-body-compact flex items-center justify-center active:scale-[0.985] hover:bg-surface-container-high transition-all cursor-pointer" id="btn-dismiss-fallback">
      Keep Alerts Muted &amp; Rely on Calendar
    </button>
</div>
<!-- Trust Guarantee Footer -->
<div class="flex items-center justify-center gap-space-xs text-center mt-space-lg mb-space-xl px-space-md">
<span class="material-symbols-outlined text-muted-foreground text-[16px]">verified_user</span>
<p class="font-caption text-caption text-muted-foreground">
      No promotional spam. Only critical event alerts and scan confirmations.
    </p>
</div>
</div>
<script>
  // Simple micro-interactions for feedback on buttons
  document.getElementById('btn-open-settings')?.addEventListener('click', () => {
    const btn = document.getElementById('btn-open-settings');
    btn.innerHTML = '<span class="material-symbols-outlined animate-spin text-[20px]">sync</span><span>Opening Settings...</span>';
    setTimeout(() => {
      // Fallback feedback simulation
      btn.innerHTML = '<span>Enable in Settings</span><span class="material-symbols-outlined text-[20px]">arrow_forward</span>';
    }, 1200);
  });

  document.getElementById('btn-dismiss-fallback')?.addEventListener('click', () => {
    const card = document.getElementById('btn-dismiss-fallback');
    card.classList.add('opacity-50');
    setTimeout(() => {
      if (window.history.length > 1) {
        window.history.back();
      }
    }, 200);
  });
</script></main></body></html>

      "styleGuidelines": "## Brand & Style\n\nThis design system defines an AI-powered screenshot utility that bridges media capture and calendar scheduling through a glass-tech interface. The visual language balances high-velocity utility with cinematic depth, transforming chaotic on-screen captures into structured temporal actions.\n\n### Design Movements & Tone\n- **Atmospheric Glassmorphism:** Heavy reliance on optical multi-layering, translucent surfaces, specularity, and frosted backdrop blurs (`20px` to `24px`). Surfaces mimic precision-milled optical glass panels suspended in a dark vacuum.\n- **Cinematic Futurism & Neon Precision:** Laser-like scanning beams, neon cyan tiles, and warm laser bursts provide targeted points of interactive energy without cluttering information density.\n- **Tone Matrix:** Focused, dependable, frictionless, and intelligent. The UI avoids playful cartoonishness and sterile monochrome minimalism, balancing engineered precision with responsive visual feedback.\n\n## Layout & Spacing\n\nLayouts follow a fluid, device-aware single-column structure for mobile viewports, expanding to a balanced multi-column modular grid on larger screens.\n\n### Spatial Rhythms\n- **Canvas Margins:** Mobile viewports strictly maintain `16px` (`margin: 1rem`) horizontal outer margins. iPads and large display formats expand to `24px` (`margin-tablet: 1.5rem`).\n- **Vertical Hierarchy:**\n  - Micro-element spacing (icon-to-text, chip gaps): `4px` to `8px` (`space-xs` to `space-sm`).\n  - Card internal padding: `20px` (`space-lg`) on mobile; `24px` (`space-xl`) on expanded cards.\n  - Inter-card flow: `16px` to `20px` (`space-md` to `space-lg`).\n  - Section-to-section separation: `32px` (`space-xxl`).\n- **iOS Safe Areas:** Pinned navigation components factor in hardware constraints: top headers offset by `54pt` for the Dynamic Island; bottom sheets and floating toolbars account for the `34pt` home indicator.\n\n## Elevation & Depth\n\nVisual hierarchy uses physical optics, layered refraction, and multi-tone rims rather than standard drop shadows.\n\n### The Optical Glass Model\n1. **Level 0 (Canvas):** Solid background in Deep Midnight Navy (`#050816`).\n2. **Level 1 (Subtle Inset / Inactive Track):** `rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05)` to `0.08` fill without blur for inactive pills and segmented controls.\n3. **Level 2 (Translucent Glass Paneling):** Applied to ActionCards, DateBadges, and bottom navigation bars. Fills use `rgba(18, 24, 52, 0.72)` supported by a `20px` to `24px` backdrop blur (`backdrop-filter: blur(20px)`).\n4. **Level 3 (Interactive Floating Sheets & Modals):** Foreground popovers and modal ScanSheets sit over a backdrop scrim (`rgba(4, 8, 22, 0.72)`) with a `30px` Gaussian blur.\n\n### Keyline Specularity & Border Rims\nEvery elevated glass panel uses a dual-edge lighting system:\n- **Base Perimeter Hairline:** A continuous 1px stroke using `rgba(173, 195, 255, 0.18)` provides structural definition against deep canvas backgrounds.\n- **Specular Top-Edge Rim:** An inner top highlight of 1px using `rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.22)` simulates an overhead key light refracting along the bevel of an optical glass sheet.\n- **Focused State Glows:** Selected states project an ambient radial wash of `0 0 20px rgba(124, 255, 234, 0.25)`.\n\n## Components\n\n### Buttons\n- **Primary CTA (\"Add to Calendar\"):** Capsule geometry (`28px` radius), height `56px`. Filled with solid Electric Cyan (`#7CFFEA`), using `#07111F` foreground in Sora/Inter 14px SemiBold. Emits a subtle cyan bloom shadow (`0 6px 20px rgba(124, 255, 234, 0.28)`). On touch down, scales to `0.985` over `0.16s`.\n- **Secondary Glass Button:** Translucent fill `rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08)`, 1px perimeter border `rgba(173, 195, 255, 0.18)`, top highlight `rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.22)`. Typography in `#F7F8FF`. Touch state increases background opacity to `0.14`.\n- **Destructive / Dismiss Button:** Low-profile ghost pill with transparent base and `#FF6B7A` text; active state reveals an ambient `rgba(255, 107, 122, 0.12)` fill.\n\n### ActionCard (Extracted Event Tile)\n- Translucent obsidian glass panel (`rgba(18, 24, 52, 0.72)`) with `24px` radius, `20px` internal padding, and `24px` backdrop blur.\n- Dual-edge lighting: 1px `rgba(173, 195, 255, 0.18)` perimeter border plus a 1px top highlight `rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.22)`.\n- **Internal Layout:** Horizontal leading lockup housing the 56x68px `DateBadge`, stacked middle block holding the event title (20px Sora SemiBold) and event time/location (14px Inter Regular in `#A8B0D4`), and trailing confidence pill.\n\n### DateBadge\n- Compact temporal anchor: `56px` wide by `68px` tall, `16px` corner radius.\n- Centered vertical stack: Month string in 11px Sora SemiBold uppercase (`#A8B0D4`), Day integer in 20px Sora Bold (`#F7F8FF`).\n- Border treatment matches the parent ActionCard. Active/selected state introduces a subtle cyan keyline rim glow.\n\n### Confidence Pills\n- Height: `24px`, capsule geometry (`9999px`), internal horizontal padding `10px`.\n- Layout: 12px semantic icon + 11px Sora SemiBold text tracking the confidence score.\n- **High (90%+):** Surface `rgba(70, 227, 154, 0.14)`, border `1px solid rgba(70, 227, 154, 0.40)`, text `#46E39A`.\n- **Medium (60%-89%):** Surface `rgba(255, 190, 85, 0.14)`, border `1px solid rgba(255, 190, 85, 0.40)`, text `#FFBE55`.\n- **Low (<60%):** Surface `rgba(255, 107, 122, 0.14)`, border `1px solid rgba(255, 107, 122, 0.40)`, text `#FF6B7A`.\n\n### ScanSheet & Beam Motion\n- Native bottom sheet container with `32px` top rounded corners and `30px` backdrop blur.\n- Pinned top edge highlighted by a continuous 1px specular line (`rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.22)`).\n- **The Scan Beam:** A horizontal 2px ray translating vertically over the screenshot capture:\n  - Fill: `linear-gradient(90deg, #FF8A3D 0%, #FF4FB3 48%, #7B61FF 100%)`.\n  - Ambient glow: `0 0 16px rgba(255, 79, 179, 0.65)`.\n  - Motion: `1.8s` linear infinite oscillation. When reduced motion is preferred, shifts to a gentle `1.2s` opacity pulse.\n\n### Glass TabBar\n- Floating bottom dock: Height `84px` to `88px` (inclusive of safe area margins), surface `rgba(10, 14, 30, 0.72)` with `20px` material blur.\n- Structural boundary: 1px top hairline `rgba(173, 195, 255, 0.18)` without bottom/side borders.\n- **Active Route Indicator:** Rounded pill halo (`rgba(124, 255, 234, 0.12)`) anchoring the active icon, with the icon and label tinted in Electric Cyan (`#7CFFEA`). Idle icons rest in `#A8B0D4` at `65%` opacity.\n\n### Form Inputs & Toggles\n- **Glass Text Input:** Height `52px`, `16px` radius, filled with `rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05)`. Active focus transitions border to `#7CFFEA` with a matching `0 0 12px rgba(124, 255, 234, 0.25)` halo.\n- **Toggle Card:** Min-height `84px`, `20px` radius. Features a glass row background. The active switch state displays an Electric Cyan thumb track accented by a subtle Neon Magenta halo edge.",

 letterSpacing: 0em\n  body-compact:\n    fontFamily: Inter\n    fontSize: 14px\n    fontWeight: '500'\n    lineHeight: 20px\n    letterSpacing: 0.01em\n  label-chip:\n    fontFamily: Inter\n 0.5rem\n  md: 0.75rem\n  lg: 1rem\n  xl: 1.5rem\n  full: 9999px\nspacing:\n  gutter: 1rem\n  gutter-tablet: 1.25rem\n  margin: 1rem\n  margin-tablet: 1.5rem\n  margin-desktop: 2rem\n  space-xs: 0.25rem\n  space-sm: 0.5rem\n  space-md: 1rem\n  space-lg: 1.25rem\n  space-xl: 1.5rem\n  space-xxl: 2rem\n---\n\n## Brand & Style\n\nThis design system defines an AI-powered screenshot utility that bridges media capture and calendar scheduling through a glass-tech interface. The visual language balances high-velocity utility with cinematic depth, transforming chaotic on-screen captures into structured temporal actions.\n\n### Design Movements & Tone\n- **Atmospheric Glassmorphism:** Heavy reliance on optical multi-layering, translucent surfaces, specularity, and frosted backdrop blurs (`20px` to `24px`). Surfaces mimic precision-milled optical glass panels suspended in a dark vacuum.\n- **Cinematic Futurism & Neon Precision:** Laser-like scanning beams, neon cyan tiles, and warm laser bursts provide targeted points of interactive energy without cluttering information density.\n- **Tone Matrix:** Focused, dependable, frictionless, and intelligent. The UI avoids playful cartoonishness and sterile monochrome minimalism, balancing engineered precision with responsive visual feedback.\n\n## Colors\n\nThe palette operates natively in Apple **Display P3** wide color space, with fallback to sRGB. The dark-first palette uses midnight navy (`#050816`) instead of pure black (`#000000`) to preserve dimensional separation between the canvas and layered glass surfaces.\n\n### Core Architecture\n- **Primary (`#7CFFEA`):** Derived from the vibrant cyan key tile. Used for active confirmations, high-confidence bounding tags, focused toggles, and primary CTA capsules. Text/icons on solid primary fills use `#07111F`.\n- **Secondary (`#5B7CFF`):** Vibrant indigo used for persistent navigation accents, active tab markers, and cool ambient backdrop undertones.\n- **Tertiary (`#FF4FB3`):** High-energy neon magenta that acts as the scan core and celebration hue. Paired with thermal orange (`#FF8A3D`) in dynamic scan beams.\n- **Neutral (`#050816`):** Deep oceanic navy canvas serving as the ground foundation across all primary screens.\n\n### Signature Gradients\n- **Scan Beam Gradient:** `linear-gradient(90deg, #FF8A3D 0%, #FF4FB3 48%, #7B61FF 100%)` for OCR sweeping animations and processing bars.\n- **Brand Aurora Gradient:** `linear-gradient(135deg, #32C5FF 0%, #5B7CFF 30%, #9D4DFF 62%, #FF4FB3 82%, #FF8A3D 100%)` for hero milestone surfaces and primary action badges.\n\n### Color Rules & Hierarchy\n- Limit bright gradient sweeps and saturated glows to a single dominant focal point per viewport.\n- Never place raw `#F7F8FF` text directly over unclamped linear gradients; provide a translucent `#050816` or `rgba(18, 24, 52, 0.72)` glass barrier to preserve WCAG AA contrast.\n\n## Typography\n\nThe typographic hierarchy pairs the geometric personality of **Sora** with the neutral legibility of **Inter** (or Apple system **SF Pro** in native compilation).\n\n### Structural Roles\n- **Sora (Display & Metrics):** Applied across all structural anchors\u2014large screen headings, hero extraction stats, DateBadge calendar numerals, and uppercase metric tags. The tight geometric apertures provide technical authority.\n- **Inter / SF Pro (UI & Parsing Engine):** Applied to narrative event descriptions, interactive button labels, input fields, and timestamps.\n- **11px Overlines:** Strictly transformed to uppercase with positive letter tracking (`+0.04em`) to establish visual landmarks without pulling weight away from primary event titles.\n- **Input Scaling:** Standard body inputs are locked to a minimum `16px` to prevent viewport auto-zooming on mobile web and iOS Safari views.\n\n## Layout & Spacing\n\nLayouts follow a fluid, device-aware single-column structure for mobile viewports, expanding to a balanced multi-column modular grid on larger screens.\n\n### Spatial Rhythms\n- **Canvas Margins:** Mobile viewports strictly maintain `16px` (`margin: 1rem`) horizontal outer margins. iPads and large display formats expand to `24px` (`margin-tablet: 1.5rem`).\n- **Vertical Hierarchy:**\n  - Micro-element spacing (icon-to-text, chip gaps): `4px` to `8px` (`space-xs` to `space-sm`).\n  - Card internal padding: `20px` (`space-lg`) on mobile; `24px` (`space-xl`) on expanded cards.\n  - Inter-card flow: `16px` to `20px` (`space-md` to `space-lg`).\n  - Section-to-section separation: `32px` (`space-xxl`).\n- **iOS Safe Areas:** Pinned navigation components factor in hardware constraints: top headers offset by `54pt` for the Dynamic Island; bottom sheets and floating toolbars account for the `34pt` home indicator.\n\n## Elevation & Depth\n\nVisual hierarchy uses physical optics, layered refraction, and multi-tone rims rather than standard drop shadows.\n\n### The Optical Glass Model\n1. **Level 0 (Canvas):** Solid background in Deep Midnight Navy (`#050816`).\n2. **Level 1 (Subtle Inset / Inactive Track):** `rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05)` to `0.08` fill without blur for inactive pills and segmented controls.\n3. **Level 2 (Translucent Glass Paneling):** Applied to ActionCards, DateBadges, and bottom navigation bars. Fills use `rgba(18, 24, 52, 0.72)` supported by a `20px` to `24px` backdrop blur (`backdrop-filter: blur(20px)`).\n4. **Level 3 (Interactive Floating Sheets & Modals):** Foreground popovers and modal ScanSheets sit over a backdrop scrim (`rgba(4, 8, 22, 0.72)`) with a `30px` Gaussian blur.\n\n### Keyline Specularity & Border Rims\nEvery elevated glass panel uses a dual-edge lighting system:\n- **Base Perimeter Hairline:** A continuous 1px stroke using `rgba(173, 195, 255, 0.18)` provides structural definition against deep canvas backgrounds.\n- **Specular Top-Edge Rim:** An inner top highlight of 1px using `rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.22)` simulates an overhead key light refracting along the bevel of an optical glass sheet.\n- **Focused State Glows:** Selected states project an ambient radial wash of `0 0 20px rgba(124, 255, 234, 0.25)`.\n\n## Shapes\n\nThe shape system balances structural clarity with rounded glass ergonomics. Interactive components use higher radii to provide tactile touch targets.\n\n### Radius Assignments\n- **DateBadges & Confidence Chips:** `16px` radius (`rounded-lg`).\n- **Toggle Cards & Text Inputs:** `16px` to `20px` radius.\n- **ActionCards:** `24px` radius (`rounded-xl`).\n- **Hero Display Panels:** `26px` radius.\n- **CTA Action Buttons:** `28px` radius (producing continuous capsules at 56px heights).\n- **ScanSheets (Bottom Sheets):** `32px` radius along top leading corners.\n- **Confidence Pills & Status Badges:** `9999px` (full capsule).\n\n## Components\n\n### Buttons\n- **Primary CTA (\"Add to Calendar\"):** Capsule geometry (`28px` radius), height `56px`. Filled with solid Electric Cyan (`#7CFFEA`), using `#07111F` foreground in Sora/Inter 14px SemiBold. Emits a subtle cyan bloom shadow (`0 6px 20px rgba(124, 255, 234, 0.28)`). On touch down, scales to `0.985` over `0.16s`.\n- **Secondary Glass Button:** Translucent fill `rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08)`, 1px perimeter border `rgba(173, 195, 255, 0.18)`, top highlight `rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.22)`. Typography in `#F7F8FF`. Touch state increases background opacity to `0.14`.\n- **Destructive / Dismiss Button:** Low-profile ghost pill with transparent base and `#FF6B7A` text; active state reveals an ambient `rgba(255, 107, 122, 0.12)` fill.\n\n### ActionCard (Extracted Event Tile)\n- Translucent obsidian glass panel (`rgba(18, 24, 52, 0.72)`) with `24px` radius, `20px` internal padding, and `24px` backdrop blur.\n- Dual-edge lighting: 1px `rgba(173, 195, 255, 0.18)` perimeter border plus a 1px top highlight `rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.22)`.\n- **Internal Layout:** Horizontal leading lockup housing the 56x68px `DateBadge`, stacked middle block holding the event title (20px Sora SemiBold) and event time/location (14px Inter Regular in `#A8B0D4`), and trailing confidence pill.\n\n### DateBadge\n- Compact temporal anchor: `56px` wide by `68px` tall, `16px` corner radius.\n- Centered vertical stack: Month string in 11px Sora SemiBold uppercase (`#A8B0D4`), Day integer in 20px Sora Bold (`#F7F8FF`).\n- Border treatment matches the parent ActionCard. Active/selected state introduces a subtle cyan keyline rim glow.\n\n### Confidence Pills\n- Height: `24px`, capsule geometry (`9999px`), internal horizontal padding `10px`.\n- Layout: 12px semantic icon + 11px Sora SemiBold text tracking the confidence score.\n- **High (90%+):** Surface `rgba(70, 227, 154, 0.14)`, border `1px solid rgba(70, 227, 154, 0.40)`, text `#46E39A`.\n- **Medium (60%-89%):** Surface `rgba(255, 190, 85, 0.14)`, border `1px solid rgba(255, 190, 85, 0.40)`, text `#FFBE55`.\n- **Low (<60%):** Surface `rgba(255, 107, 122, 0.14)`, border `1px solid rgba(255, 107, 122, 0.40)`, text `#FF6B7A`.\n\n### ScanSheet & Beam Motion\n- Native bottom sheet container with `32px` top rounded corners and `30px` backdrop blur.\n- Pinned top edge highlighted by a continuous 1px specular line (`rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.22)`).\n- **The Scan Beam:** A horizontal 2px ray translating vertically over the screenshot capture:\n  - Fill: `linear-gradient(90deg, #FF8A3D 0%, #FF4FB3 48%, #7B61FF 100%)`.\n  - Ambient glow: `0 0 16px rgba(255, 79, 179, 0.65)`.\n  - Motion: `1.8s` linear infinite oscillation. When reduced motion is preferred, shifts to a gentle `1.2s` opacity pulse.\n\n### Glass TabBar\n- Floating bottom dock: Height `84px` to `88px` (inclusive of safe area margins), surface `rgba(10, 14, 30, 0.72)` with `20px` material blur.\n- Structural boundary: 1px top hairline `rgba(173, 195, 255, 0.18)` without bottom/side borders.\n- **Active Route Indicator:** Rounded pill halo (`rgba(124, 255, 234, 0.12)`) anchoring the active icon, with the icon and label tinted in Electric Cyan (`#7CFFEA`). Idle icons rest in `#A8B0D4` at `65%` opacity.\n\n### Form Inputs & Toggles\n- **Glass Text Input:** Height `52px`, `16px` radius, filled with `rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05)`. Active focus transitions border to `#7CFFEA` with a matching `0 0 12px rgba(124, 255, 234, 0.25)` halo.\n- **Toggle Card:** Min-height `84px`, `20px` radius. Features a glass row background. The active switch state displays an Electric Cyan thumb track accented by a subtle Neon Magenta halo edge.",

      "styleGuidelines": "## Brand & Style\n\nThis design system defines an AI-powered screenshot utility that bridges media capture and calendar scheduling through a glass-tech interface. The visual language balances high-velocity utility with cinematic depth, transforming chaotic on-screen captures into structured temporal actions.\n\n### Design Movements & Tone\n- **Atmospheric Glassmorphism:** Heavy reliance on optical multi-layering, translucent surfaces, specularity, and frosted backdrop blurs (`20px` to `24px`). Surfaces mimic precision-milled optical glass panels suspended in a dark vacuum.\n- **Cinematic Futurism & Neon Precision:** Laser-like scanning beams, neon cyan tiles, and warm laser bursts provide targeted points of interactive energy without cluttering information density.\n- **Tone Matrix:** Focused, dependable, frictionless, and intelligent. The UI avoids playful cartoonishness and sterile monochrome minimalism, balancing engineered precision with responsive visual feedback.\n\n## Layout & Spacing\n\nLayouts follow a fluid, device-aware single-column structure for mobile viewports, expanding to a balanced multi-column modular grid on larger screens.\n\n### Spatial Rhythms\n- **Canvas Margins:** Mobile viewports strictly maintain `16px` (`margin: 1rem`) horizontal outer margins. iPads and large display formats expand to `24px` (`margin-tablet: 1.5rem`).\n- **Vertical Hierarchy:**\n  - Micro-element spacing (icon-to-text, chip gaps): `4px` to `8px` (`space-xs` to `space-sm`).\n  - Card internal padding: `20px` (`space-lg`) on mobile; `24px` (`space-xl`) on expanded cards.\n  - Inter-card flow: `16px` to `20px` (`space-md` to `space-lg`).\n  - Section-to-section separation: `32px` (`space-xxl`).\n- **iOS Safe Areas:** Pinned navigation components factor in hardware constraints: top headers offset by `54pt` for the Dynamic Island; bottom sheets and floating toolbars account for the `34pt` home indicator.\n\n## Elevation & Depth\n\nVisual hierarchy uses physical optics, layered refraction, and multi-tone rims rather than standard drop shadows.\n\n### The Optical Glass Model\n1. **Level 0 (Canvas):** Solid background in Deep Midnight Navy (`#050816`).\n2. **Level 1 (Subtle Inset / Inactive Track):** `rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05)` to `0.08` fill without blur for inactive pills and segmented controls.\n3. **Level 2 (Translucent Glass Paneling):** Applied to ActionCards, DateBadges, and bottom navigation bars. Fills use `rgba(18, 24, 52, 0.72)` supported by a `20px` to `24px` backdrop blur (`backdrop-filter: blur(20px)`).\n4. **Level 3 (Interactive Floating Sheets & Modals):** Foreground popovers and modal ScanSheets sit over a backdrop scrim (`rgba(4, 8, 22, 0.72)`) with a `30px` Gaussian blur.\n\n### Keyline Specularity & Border Rims\nEvery elevated glass panel uses a dual-edge lighting system:\n- **Base Perimeter Hairline:** A continuous 1px stroke using `rgba(173, 195, 255, 0.18)` provides structural definition against deep canvas backgrounds.\n- **Specular Top-Edge Rim:** An inner top highlight of 1px using `rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.22)` simulates an overhead key light refracting along the bevel of an optical glass sheet.\n- **Focused State Glows:** Selected states project an ambient radial wash of `0 0 20px rgba(124, 255, 234, 0.25)`.\n\n## Components\n\n### Buttons\n- **Primary CTA (\"Add to Calendar\"):** Capsule geometry (`28px` radius), height `56px`. Filled with solid Electric Cyan (`#7CFFEA`), using `#07111F` foreground in Sora/Inter 14px SemiBold. Emits a subtle cyan bloom shadow (`0 6px 20px rgba(124, 255, 234, 0.28)`). On touch down, scales to `0.985` over `0.16s`.\n- **Secondary Glass Button:** Translucent fill `rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08)`, 1px perimeter border `rgba(173, 195, 255, 0.18)`, top highlight `rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.22)`. Typography in `#F7F8FF`. Touch state increases background opacity to `0.14`.\n- **Destructive / Dismiss Button:** Low-profile ghost pill with transparent base and `#FF6B7A` text; active state reveals an ambient `rgba(255, 107, 122, 0.12)` fill.\n\n### ActionCard (Extracted Event Tile)\n- Translucent obsidian glass panel (`rgba(18, 24, 52, 0.72)`) with `24px` radius, `20px` internal padding, and `24px` backdrop blur.\n- Dual-edge lighting: 1px `rgba(173, 195, 255, 0.18)` perimeter border plus a 1px top highlight `rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.22)`.\n- **Internal Layout:** Horizontal leading lockup housing the 56x68px `DateBadge`, stacked middle block holding the event title (20px Sora SemiBold) and event time/location (14px Inter Regular in `#A8B0D4`), and trailing confidence pill.\n\n### DateBadge\n- Compact temporal anchor: `56px` wide by `68px` tall, `16px` corner radius.\n- Centered vertical stack: Month string in 11px Sora SemiBold uppercase (`#A8B0D4`), Day integer in 20px Sora Bold (`#F7F8FF`).\n- Border treatment matches the parent ActionCard. Active/selected state introduces a subtle cyan keyline rim glow.\n\n### Confidence Pills\n- Height: `24px`, capsule geometry (`9999px`), internal horizontal padding `10px`.\n- Layout: 12px semantic icon + 11px Sora SemiBold text tracking the confidence score.\n- **High (90%+):** Surface `rgba(70, 227, 154, 0.14)`, border `1px solid rgba(70, 227, 154, 0.40)`, text `#46E39A`.\n- **Medium (60%-89%):** Surface `rgba(255, 190, 85, 0.14)`, border `1px solid rgba(255, 190, 85, 0.40)`, text `#FFBE55`.\n- **Low (<60%):** Surface `rgba(255, 107, 122, 0.14)`, border `1px solid rgba(255, 107, 122, 0.40)`, text `#FF6B7A`.\n\n### ScanSheet & Beam Motion\n- Native bottom sheet container with `32px` top rounded corners and `30px` backdrop blur.\n- Pinned top edge highlighted by a continuous 1px specular line (`rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.22)`).\n- **The Scan Beam:** A horizontal 2px ray translating vertically over the screenshot capture:\n  - Fill: `linear-gradient(90deg, #FF8A3D 0%, #FF4FB3 48%, #7B61FF 100%)`.\n  - Ambient glow: `0 0 16px rgba(255, 79, 179, 0.65)`.\n  - Motion: `1.8s` linear infinite oscillation. When reduced motion is preferred, shifts to a gentle `1.2s` opacity pulse.\n\n### Glass TabBar\n- Floating bottom dock: Height `84px` to `88px` (inclusive of safe area margins), surface `rgba(10, 14, 30, 0.72)` with `20px` material blur.\n- Structural boundary: 1px top hairline `rgba(173, 195, 255, 0.18)` without bottom/side borders.\n- **Active Route Indicator:** Rounded pill halo (`rgba(124, 255, 234, 0.12)`) anchoring the active icon, with the icon and label tinted in Electric Cyan (`#7CFFEA`). Idle icons rest in `#A8B0D4` at `65%` opacity.\n\n### Form Inputs & Toggles\n- **Glass Text Input:** Height `52px`, `16px` radius, filled with `rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05)`. Active focus transitions border to `#7CFFEA` with a matching `0 0 12px rgba(124, 255, 234, 0.25)` halo.\n- **Toggle Card:** Min-height `84px`, `20px` radius. Features a glass row background. The active switch state displays an Electric Cyan thumb track accented by a subtle Neon Magenta halo edge.",

0.25rem\n  space-sm: 0.5rem\n  space-md: 1rem\n  space-lg: 1.25rem\n  space-xl: 1.5rem\n  space-xxl: 2rem\n---\n\n## Brand & Style\n\nThis design system defines an AI-powered screenshot utility that bridges media capture and calendar scheduling through a glass-tech interface. The visual language balances high-velocity utility with cinematic depth, transforming chaotic on-screen captures into structured temporal actions.\n\n### Design Movements & Tone\n- **Atmospheric Glassmorphism:** Heavy reliance on optical multi-layering, translucent surfaces, specularity, and frosted backdrop blurs (`20px` to `24px`). Surfaces mimic precision-milled optical glass panels suspended in a dark vacuum.\n- **Cinematic Futurism & Neon Precision:** Laser-like scanning beams, neon cyan tiles, and warm laser bursts provide targeted points of interactive energy without cluttering information density.\n- **Tone Matrix:** Focused, dependable, frictionless, and intelligent. The UI avoids playful cartoonishness and sterile monochrome minimalism, balancing engineered precision with responsive visual feedback.\n\n## Colors\n\nThe palette operates natively in Apple **Display P3** wide color space, with fallback to sRGB. The dark-first palette uses midnight navy (`#050816`) instead of pure black (`#000000`) to preserve dimensional separation between the canvas and layered glass surfaces.\n\n### Core Architecture\n- **Primary (`#7CFFEA`):** Derived from the vibrant cyan key tile. Used for active confirmations, high-confidence bounding tags, focused toggles, and primary CTA capsules. Text/icons on solid primary fills use `#07111F`.\n- **Secondary (`#5B7CFF`):** Vibrant indigo used for persistent navigation accents, active tab markers, and cool ambient backdrop undertones.\n- **Tertiary (`#FF4FB3`):** High-energy neon magenta that acts as the scan core and celebration hue. Paired with thermal orange (`#FF8A3D`) in dynamic scan beams.\n- **Neutral (`#050816`):** Deep oceanic navy canvas serving as the ground foundation across all primary screens.\n\n### Signature Gradients\n- **Scan Beam Gradient:** `linear-gradient(90deg, #FF8A3D 0%, #FF4FB3 48%, #7B61FF 100%)` for OCR sweeping animations and processing bars.\n- **Brand Aurora Gradient:** `linear-gradient(135deg, #32C5FF 0%, #5B7CFF 30%, #9D4DFF 62%, #FF4FB3 82%, #FF8A3D 100%)` for hero milestone surfaces and primary action badges.\n\n### Color Rules & Hierarchy\n- Limit bright gradient sweeps and saturated glows to a single dominant focal point per viewport.\n- Never place raw `#F7F8FF` text directly over unclamped linear gradients; provide a translucent `#050816` or `rgba(18, 24, 52, 0.72)` glass barrier to preserve WCAG AA contrast.\n\n## Typography\n\nThe typographic hierarchy pairs the geometric personality of **Sora** with the neutral legibility of **Inter** (or Apple system **SF Pro** in native compilation).\n\n### Structural Roles\n- **Sora (Display & Metrics):** Applied across all structural anchors\u2014large screen headings, hero extraction stats, DateBadge calendar numerals, and uppercase metric tags. The tight geometric apertures provide technical authority.\n- **Inter / SF Pro (UI & Parsing Engine):** Applied to narrative event descriptions, interactive button labels, input fields, and timestamps.\n- **11px Overlines:** Strictly transformed to uppercase with positive letter tracking (`+0.04em`) to establish visual landmarks without pulling weight away from primary event titles.\n- **Input Scaling:** Standard body inputs are locked to a minimum `16px` to prevent viewport auto-zooming on mobile web and iOS Safari views.\n\n## Layout & Spacing\n\nLayouts follow a fluid, device-aware single-column structure for mobile viewports, expanding to a balanced multi-column modular grid on larger screens.\n\n### Spatial Rhythms\n- **Canvas Margins:** Mobile viewports strictly maintain `16px` (`margin: 1rem`) horizontal outer margins. iPads and large display formats expand to `24px` (`margin-tablet: 1.5rem`).\n- **Vertical Hierarchy:**\n  - Micro-element spacing (icon-to-text, chip gaps): `4px` to `8px` (`space-xs` to `space-sm`).\n  - Card internal padding: `20px` (`space-lg`) on mobile; `24px` (`space-xl`) on expanded cards.\n  - Inter-card flow: `16px` to `20px` (`space-md` to `space-lg`).\n  - Section-to-section separation: `32px` (`space-xxl`).\n- **iOS Safe Areas:** Pinned navigation components factor in hardware constraints: top headers offset by `54pt` for the Dynamic Island; bottom sheets and floating toolbars account for the `34pt` home indicator.\n\n## Elevation & Depth\n\nVisual hierarchy uses physical optics, layered refraction, and multi-tone rims rather than standard drop shadows.\n\n### The Optical Glass Model\n1. **Level 0 (Canvas):** Solid background in Deep Midnight Navy (`#050816`).\n2. **Level 1 (Subtle Inset / Inactive Track):** `rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05)` to `0.08` fill without blur for inactive pills and segmented controls.\n3. **Level 2 (Translucent Glass Paneling):** Applied to ActionCards, DateBadges, and bottom navigation bars. Fills use `rgba(18, 24, 52, 0.72)` supported by a `20px` to `24px` backdrop blur (`backdrop-filter: blur(20px)`).\n4. **Level 3 (Interactive Floating Sheets & Modals):** Foreground popovers and modal ScanSheets sit over a backdrop scrim (`rgba(4, 8, 22, 0.72)`) with a `30px` Gaussian blur.\n\n### Keyline Specularity & Border Rims\nEvery elevated glass panel uses a dual-edge lighting system:\n- **Base Perimeter Hairline:** A continuous 1px stroke using `rgba(173, 195, 255, 0.18)` provides structural definition against deep canvas backgrounds.\n- **Specular Top-Edge Rim:** An inner top highlight of 1px using `rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.22)` simulates an overhead key light refracting along the bevel of an optical glass sheet.\n- **Focused State Glows:** Selected states project an ambient radial wash of `0 0 20px rgba(124, 255, 234, 0.25)`.\n\n## Shapes\n\nThe shape system balances structural clarity with rounded glass ergonomics. Interactive components use higher radii to provide tactile touch targets.\n\n### Radius Assignments\n- **DateBadges & Confidence Chips:** `16px` radius (`rounded-lg`).\n- **Toggle Cards & Text Inputs:** `16px` to `20px` radius.\n- **ActionCards:** `24px` radius (`rounded-xl`).\n- **Hero Display Panels:** `26px` radius.\n- **CTA Action Buttons:** `28px` radius (producing continuous capsules at 56px heights).\n- **ScanSheets (Bottom Sheets):** `32px` radius along top leading corners.\n- **Confidence Pills & Status Badges:** `9999px` (full capsule).\n\n## Components\n\n### Buttons\n- **Primary CTA (\"Add to Calendar\"):** Capsule geometry (`28px` radius), height `56px`. Filled with solid Electric Cyan (`#7CFFEA`), using `#07111F` foreground in Sora/Inter 14px SemiBold. Emits a subtle cyan bloom shadow (`0 6px 20px rgba(124, 255, 234, 0.28)`). On touch down, scales to `0.985` over `0.16s`.\n- **Secondary Glass Button:** Translucent fill `rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08)`, 1px perimeter border `rgba(173, 195, 255, 0.18)`, top highlight `rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.22)`. Typography in `#F7F8FF`. Touch state increases background opacity to `0.14`.\n- **Destructive / Dismiss Button:** Low-profile ghost pill with transparent base and `#FF6B7A` text; active state reveals an ambient `rgba(255, 107, 122, 0.12)` fill.\n\n### ActionCard (Extracted Event Tile)\n- Translucent obsidian glass panel (`rgba(18, 24, 52, 0.72)`) with `24px` radius, `20px` internal padding, and `24px` backdrop blur.\n- Dual-edge lighting: 1px `rgba(173, 195, 255, 0.18)` perimeter border plus a 1px top highlight `rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.22)`.\n- **Internal Layout:** Horizontal leading lockup housing the 56x68px `DateBadge`, stacked middle block holding the event title (20px Sora SemiBold) and event time/location (14px Inter Regular in `#A8B0D4`), and trailing confidence pill.\n\n### DateBadge\n- Compact temporal anchor: `56px` wide by `68px` tall, `16px` corner radius.\n- Centered vertical stack: Month string in 11px Sora SemiBold uppercase (`#A8B0D4`), Day integer in 20px Sora Bold (`#F7F8FF`).\n- Border treatment matches the parent ActionCard. Active/selected state introduces a subtle cyan keyline rim glow.\n\n### Confidence Pills\n- Height: `24px`, capsule geometry (`9999px`), internal horizontal padding `10px`.\n- Layout: 12px semantic icon + 11px Sora SemiBold text tracking the confidence score.\n- **High (90%+):** Surface `rgba(70, 227, 154, 0.14)`, border `1px solid rgba(70, 227, 154, 0.40)`, text `#46E39A`.\n- **Medium (60%-89%):** Surface `rgba(255, 190, 85, 0.14)`, border `1px solid rgba(255, 190, 85, 0.40)`, text `#FFBE55`.\n- **Low (<60%):** Surface `rgba(255, 107, 122, 0.14)`, border `1px solid rgba(255, 107, 122, 0.40)`, text `#FF6B7A`.\n\n### ScanSheet & Beam Motion\n- Native bottom sheet container with `32px` top rounded corners and `30px` backdrop blur.\n- Pinned top edge highlighted by a continuous 1px specular line (`rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.22)`).\n- **The Scan Beam:** A horizontal 2px ray translating vertically over the screenshot capture:\n  - Fill: `linear-gradient(90deg, #FF8A3D 0%, #FF4FB3 48%, #7B61FF 100%)`.\n  - Ambient glow: `0 0 16px rgba(255, 79, 179, 0.65)`.\n  - Motion: `1.8s` linear infinite oscillation. When reduced motion is preferred, shifts to a gentle `1.2s` opacity pulse.\n\n### Glass TabBar\n- Floating bottom dock: Height `84px` to `88px` (inclusive of safe area margins), surface `rgba(10, 14, 30, 0.72)` with `20px` material blur.\n- Structural boundary: 1px top hairline `rgba(173, 195, 255, 0.18)` without bottom/side borders.\n- **Active Route Indicator:** Rounded pill halo (`rgba(124, 255, 234, 0.12)`) anchoring the active icon, with the icon and label tinted in Electric Cyan (`#7CFFEA`). Idle icons rest in `#A8B0D4` at `65%` opacity.\n\n### Form Inputs & Toggles\n- **Glass Text Input:** Height `52px`, `16px` radius, filled with `rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05)`. Active focus transitions border to `#7CFFEA` with a matching `0 0 12px rgba(124, 255, 234, 0.25)` halo.\n- **Toggle Card:** Min-height `84px`, `20px` radius. Features a glass row background.   (() => {
    const scanLaser = document.getElementById('scan-laser');
    if (scanLaser) {
      let down = true;
      setInterval(() => {
        scanLaser.style.top = down ? '70px' : '6px';
        down = !down;
      }, 1400);
    }

    const sampleBtn = document.getElementById('try-sample-btn');
    const sampleResult = document.getElementById('sample-result');
    if (sampleBtn && sampleResult) {
      sampleBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
        const isHidden = sampleResult.classList.contains('hidden');
        if (isHidden) {
          sampleResult.classList.remove('hidden');
          sampleResult.classList.add('flex');
          sampleBtn.textContent = 'Hide Sample';
        } else {
          sampleResult.classList.add('hidden');
          sampleResult.classList.remove('flex');
          sampleBtn.textContent = 'Try Sample Flyer';
        }
      });
    }
  })();

      "styleGuidelines": "## Brand & Style\n\nThis design system defines an AI-powered screenshot utility that bridges media capture and calendar scheduling through a glass-tech interface.
