Surfaces mimic precision-milled optical glass panels suspended in a dark vacuum.\n- **Cinematic Futurism & Neon Precision:** Laser-like scanning beams, neon cyan tiles, and warm laser bursts provide targeted points of interactive energy without cluttering information density.\n- **Tone Matrix:** Focused, dependable, frictionless, and intelligent. The UI avoids playful cartoonishness and sterile monochrome minimalism, balancing engineered precision with responsive visual feedback.\n\n## Layout & Spacing\n\nLayouts follow a fluid, device-aware single-column structure for mobile viewports, expanding to a balanced multi-column modular grid on larger screens.\n\n### Spatial Rhythms\n- **Canvas Margins:** Mobile viewports strictly maintain `16px` (`margin: 1rem`) horizontal outer margins. iPads and large display formats expand to `24px` (`margin-tablet: 1.5rem`).\n- **Vertical Hierarchy:**\n  - Micro-element spacing (icon-to-text, chip gaps): `4px` to `8px` (`space-xs` to `space-sm`).\n  - Card internal padding: `20px` (`space-lg`) on mobile; `24px` (`space-xl`) on expanded cards.\n  - Inter-card flow: `16px` to `20px` (`space-md` to `space-lg`).\n  - Section-to-section separation: `32px` (`space-xxl`).\n- **iOS Safe Areas:** Pinned navigation components factor in hardware constraints: top headers offset by `54pt` for the Dynamic Island; bottom sheets and floating toolbars account for the `34pt` home indicator.\n\n## Elevation & Depth\n\nVisual hierarchy uses physical optics, layered refraction, and multi-tone rims rather than standard drop shadows.\n\n### The Optical Glass Model\n1. **Level 0 (Canvas):** Solid background in Deep Midnight Navy (`#050816`).\n2. **Level 1 (Subtle Inset / Inactive Track):** `rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05)` to `0.08` fill without blur for inactive pills and segmented controls.\n3. **Level 2 (Translucent Glass Paneling):** Applied to ActionCards, DateBadges, and bottom navigation bars. Fills use `rgba(18, 24, 52, 0.72)` supported by a `20px` to `24px` backdrop blur (`backdrop-filter: blur(20px)`).\n4. **Level 3 (Interactive Floating Sheets & Modals):** Foreground popovers and modal ScanSheets sit over a backdrop scrim (`rgba(4, 8, 22, 0.72)`) with a `30px` Gaussian blur.\n\n### Keyline Specularity & Border Rims\nEvery elevated glass panel uses a dual-edge lighting system:\n- **Base Perimeter Hairline:** A continuous 1px stroke using `rgba(173, 195, 255, 0.18)` provides structural definition against deep canvas backgrounds.\n- **Specular Top-Edge Rim:** An inner top highlight of 1px using `rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.22)` simulates an overhead key light refracting along the bevel of an optical glass sheet.\n- **Focused State Glows:** Selected states project an ambient radial wash of `0 0 20px rgba(124, 255, 234, 0.25)`.\n\n## Components\n\n### Buttons\n- **Primary CTA (\"Add to Calendar\"):** Capsule geometry (`28px` radius), height `56px`. Filled with solid Electric Cyan (`#7CFFEA`), using `#07111F` foreground in Sora/Inter 14px SemiBold. Emits a subtle cyan bloom shadow (`0 6px 20px rgba(124, 255, 234, 0.28)`). On touch down, scales to `0.985` over `0.16s`.\n- **Secondary Glass Button:** Translucent fill `rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08)`, 1px perimeter border `rgba(173, 195, 255, 0.18)`, top highlight `rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.22)`. Typography in `#F7F8FF`. Touch state increases background opacity to `0.14`.\n- **Destructive / Dismiss Button:** Low-profile ghost pill with transparent base and `#FF6B7A` text; active state reveals an ambient `rgba(255, 107, 122, 0.12)` fill.\n\n### ActionCard (Extracted Event Tile)\n- Translucent obsidian glass panel (`rgba(18, 24, 52, 0.72)`) with `24px` radius, `20px` internal padding, and `24px` backdrop blur.\n- Dual-edge lighting: 1px `rgba(173, 195, 255, 0.18)` perimeter border plus a 1px top highlight `rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.22)`.\n- **Internal Layout:** Horizontal leading lockup housing the 56x68px `DateBadge`, stacked middle block holding the event title (20px Sora SemiBold) and event time/location (14px Inter Regular in `#A8B0D4`), and trailing confidence pill.\n\n### DateBadge\n- Compact temporal anchor: `56px` wide by `68px` tall, `16px` corner radius.\n- Centered vertical stack: Month string in 11px Sora SemiBold uppercase (`#A8B0D4`), Day integer in 20px Sora Bold (`#F7F8FF`).\n- Border treatment matches the parent ActionCard. Active/selected state introduces a subtle cyan keyline rim glow.\n\n### Confidence Pills\n- Height: `24px`, capsule geometry (`9999px`), internal horizontal padding `10px`.\n- Layout: 12px semantic icon + 11px Sora SemiBold text tracking the confidence score.\n- **High (90%+):** Surface `rgba(70, 227, 154, 0.14)`, border `1px solid rgba(70, 227, 154, 0.40)`, text `#46E39A`.\n- **Medium (60%-89%):** Surface `rgba(255, 190, 85, 0.14)`, border `1px solid rgba(255, 190, 85, 0.40)`, text `#FFBE55`.\n- **Low (<60%):** Surface `rgba(255, 107, 122, 0.14)`, border `1px solid rgba(255, 107, 122, 0.40)`, text `#FF6B7A`.\n\n### ScanSheet & Beam Motion\n- Native bottom sheet container with `32px` top rounded corners and `30px` backdrop blur.\n- Pinned top edge highlighted by a continuous 1px specular line (`rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.22)`).\n- **The Scan Beam:** A horizontal 2px ray translating vertically over the screenshot capture:\n  - Fill: `linear-gradient(90deg, #FF8A3D 0%, #FF4FB3 48%, #7B61FF 100%)`.\n  - Ambient glow: `0 0 16px rgba(255, 79, 179, 0.65)`.\n  - Motion: `1.8s` linear infinite oscillation. When reduced motion is preferred, shifts to a gentle `1.2s` opacity pulse.\n\n### Glass TabBar\n- Floating bottom dock: Height `84px` to `88px` (inclusive of safe area margins), surface `rgba(10, 14, 30, 0.72)` with `20px` material blur.\n- Structural boundary: 1px top hairline `rgba(173, 195, 255, 0.18)` without bottom/side borders.\n- **Active Route Indicator:** Rounded pill halo (`rgba(124, 255, 234, 0.12)`) anchoring the active icon, with the icon and label tinted in Electric Cyan (`#7CFFEA`). 0.25rem\n  space-sm: 0.5rem\n  space-md: 1rem\n  space-lg: 1.25rem\n  space-xl: 1.5rem\n  space-xxl: 2rem\n---\n\n## Brand & Style\n\nThis design system defines an AI-powered screenshot utility that bridges media capture and calendar scheduling through a glass-tech interface. The visual language balances high-velocity utility with cinematic depth, transforming chaotic on-screen captures into structured temporal actions.\n\n### Design Movements & Tone\n- **Atmospheric Glassmorphism:** Heavy reliance on optical multi-layering, translucent surfaces, specularity, and frosted backdrop blurs (`20px` to `24px`). Surfaces mimic precision-milled optical glass panels suspended in a dark vacuum.\n- **Cinematic Futurism & Neon Precision:** Laser-like scanning beams, neon cyan tiles, and warm laser bursts provide targeted points of interactive energy without cluttering information density.\n- **Tone Matrix:** Focused, dependable, frictionless, and intelligent. The UI avoids playful cartoonishness and sterile monochrome minimalism, balancing engineered precision with responsive visual feedback.\n\n## Colors\n\nThe palette operates natively in Apple **Display P3** wide color space, with fallback to sRGB. The dark-first palette uses midnight navy (`#050816`) instead of pure black (`#000000`) to preserve dimensional separation between the canvas and layered glass surfaces.\n\n### Core Architecture\n- **Primary (`#7CFFEA`):** Derived from the vibrant cyan key tile. Used for active confirmations, high-confidence bounding tags, focused toggles, and primary CTA capsules. Text/icons on solid primary fills use `#07111F`.\n- **Secondary (`#5B7CFF`):** Vibrant indigo used for persistent navigation accents, active tab markers, and cool ambient backdrop undertones.\n- **Tertiary (`#FF4FB3`):** High-energy neon magenta that acts as the scan core and celebration hue. Paired with thermal orange (`#FF8A3D`) in dynamic scan beams.\n- **Neutral (`#050816`):** Deep oceanic navy canvas serving as the ground foundation across all primary screens.\n\n### Signature Gradients\n- **Scan Beam Gradient:** `linear-gradient(90deg, #FF8A3D 0%, #FF4FB3 48%, #7B61FF 100%)` for OCR sweeping animations and processing bars.\n- **Brand Aurora Gradient:** `linear-gradient(135deg, #32C5FF 0%, #5B7CFF 30%, #9D4DFF 62%, #FF4FB3 82%, #FF8A3D 100%)` for hero milestone surfaces and primary action badges.\n\n### Color Rules & Hierarchy\n- Limit bright gradient sweeps and saturated glows to a single dominant focal point per viewport.\n- Never place raw `#F7F8FF` text directly over unclamped linear gradients; provide a translucent `#050816` or `rgba(18, 24, 52, 0.72)` glass barrier to preserve WCAG AA contrast.\n\n## Typography\n\nThe typographic hierarchy pairs the geometric personality of **Sora** with the neutral legibility of **Inter** (or Apple system **SF Pro** in native compilation).\n\n### Structural Roles\n- **Sora (Display & Metrics):** Applied across all structural anchors\u2014large screen headings, hero extraction stats, DateBadge calendar numerals, and uppercase metric tags. The tight geometric apertures provide technical authority.\n- **Inter / SF Pro (UI & Parsing Engine):** Applied to narrative event descriptions, interactive button labels, input fields, and timestamps.\n- **11px Overlines:** Strictly transformed to uppercase with positive letter tracking (`+0.04em`) to establish visual landmarks without pulling weight away from primary event titles.\n- **Input Scaling:** Standard body inputs are locked to a minimum `16px` to prevent viewport auto-zooming on mobile web and iOS Safari views.\n\n## Layout & Spacing\n\nLayouts follow a fluid, device-aware single-column structure for mobile viewports, expanding to a balanced multi-column modular grid on larger screens.\n\n### Spatial Rhythms\n- **Canvas Margins:** Mobile viewports strictly maintain `16px` (`margin: 1rem`) horizontal outer margins. iPads and large display formats expand to `24px` (`margin-tablet: 1.5rem`).\n- **Vertical Hierarchy:**\n  - Micro-element spacing (icon-to-text, chip gaps): `4px` to `8px` (`space-xs` to `space-sm`).\n  - Card internal padding: `20px` (`space-lg`) on mobile; `24px` (`space-xl`) on expanded cards.\n  - Inter-card flow: `16px` to `20px` (`space-md` to `space-lg`).\n  - Section-to-section separation: `32px` (`space-xxl`).\n- **iOS Safe Areas:** Pinned navigation components factor in hardware constraints: top headers offset by `54pt` for the Dynamic Island; bottom sheets and floating toolbars account for the `34pt` home indicator.\n\n## Elevation & Depth\n\nVisual hierarchy uses physical optics, layered refraction, and multi-tone rims rather than standard drop shadows.\n\n### The Optical Glass Model\n1. **Level 0 (Canvas):** Solid background in Deep Midnight Navy (`#050816`).\n2. **Level 1 (Subtle Inset / Inactive Track):** `rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05)` to `0.08` fill without blur for inactive pills and segmented controls.\n3. **Level 2 (Translucent Glass Paneling):** Applied to ActionCards, DateBadges, and bottom navigation bars. Fills use `rgba(18, 24, 52, 0.72)` supported by a `20px` to `24px` backdrop blur (`backdrop-filter: blur(20px)`).\n4. **Level 3 (Interactive Floating Sheets & Modals):** Foreground popovers and modal ScanSheets sit over a backdrop scrim (`rgba(4, 8, 22, 0.72)`) with a `30px` Gaussian blur.\n\n### Keyline Specularity & Border Rims\nEvery elevated glass panel uses a dual-edge lighting system:\n- **Base Perimeter Hairline:** A continuous 1px stroke using `rgba(173, 195, 255, 0.18)` provides structural definition against deep canvas backgrounds.\n- **Specular Top-Edge Rim:** An inner top highlight of 1px using `rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.22)` simulates an overhead key light refracting along the bevel of an optical glass sheet.\n- **Focused State Glows:** Selected states project an ambient radial wash of `0 0 20px rgba(124, 255, 234, 0.25)`.\n\n## Shapes\n\nThe shape system balances structural clarity with rounded glass ergonomics. Interactive components use higher radii to provide tactile touch targets.\n\n### Radius Assignments\n- **DateBadges & Confidence Chips:** `16px` radius (`rounded-lg`).\n- **Toggle Cards & Text Inputs:** `16px` to `20px` radius.\n- **ActionCards:** `24px` radius (`rounded-xl`).\n- **Hero Display Panels:** `26px` radius.\n- **CTA Action Buttons:** `28px` radius (producing continuous capsules at 56px heights).\n- **ScanSheets (Bottom Sheets):** `32px` radius along top leading corners.\n- **Confidence Pills & Status Badges:** `9999px` (full capsule).\n\n## Components\n\n### Buttons\n- **Primary CTA (\"Add to Calendar\"):** Capsule geometry (`28px` radius), height `56px`. Filled with solid Electric Cyan (`#7CFFEA`), using `#07111F` foreground in Sora/Inter 14px SemiBold. Emits a subtle cyan bloom shadow (`0 6px 20px rgba(124, 255, 234, 0.28)`). On touch down, scales to `0.985` over `0.16s`.\n- **Secondary Glass Button:** Translucent fill `rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08)`, 1px perimeter border `rgba(173, 195, 255, 0.18)`, top highlight `rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.22)`. Typography in `#F7F8FF`. Touch state increases background opacity to `0.14`.\n- **Destructive / Dismiss Button:** Low-profile ghost pill with transparent base and `#FF6B7A` text; active state reveals an ambient `rgba(255, 107, 122, 0.12)` fill.\n\n### ActionCard (Extracted Event Tile)\n- Translucent obsidian glass panel (`rgba(18, 24, 52, 0.72)`) with `24px` radius, `20px` internal padding, and `24px` backdrop blur.\n- Dual-edge lighting: 1px `rgba(173, 195, 255, 0.18)` perimeter border plus a 1px top highlight `rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.22)`.\n- **Internal Layout:** Horizontal leading lockup housing the 56x68px `DateBadge`, stacked middle block holding the event title (20px Sora SemiBold) and event time/location (14px Inter Regular in `#A8B0D4`), and trailing confidence pill.\n\n### DateBadge\n- Compact temporal anchor: `56px` wide by `68px` tall, `16px` corner radius.\n- Centered vertical stack: Month string in 11px Sora SemiBold uppercase (`#A8B0D4`), Day integer in 20px Sora Bold (`#F7F8FF`).\n- Border treatment matches the parent ActionCard. Active/selected state introduces a subtle cyan keyline rim glow.\n\n### Confidence Pills\n- Height: `24px`, capsule geometry (`9999px`), internal horizontal padding `10px`.\n- Layout: 12px semantic icon + 11px Sora SemiBold text tracking the confidence score.\n- **High (90%+):** Surface `rgba(70, 227, 154, 0.14)`, border `1px solid rgba(70, 227, 154, 0.40)`, text `#46E39A`.\n- **Medium (60%-89%):** Surface `rgba(255, 190, 85, 0.14)`, border `1px solid rgba(255, 190, 85, 0.40)`, text `#FFBE55`.\n- **Low (<60%):** Surface `rgba(255, 107, 122, 0.14)`, border `1px solid rgba(255, 107, 122, 0.40)`, text `#FF6B7A`.\n\n### ScanSheet & Beam Motion\n- Native bottom sheet container with `32px` top rounded corners and `30px` backdrop blur.\n- Pinned top edge highlighted by a continuous 1px specular line (`rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.22)`).\n- **The Scan Beam:** A horizontal 2px ray translating vertically over the screenshot capture:\n  - Fill: `linear-gradient(90deg, #FF8A3D 0%, #FF4FB3 48%, #7B61FF 100%)`.\n  - Ambient glow: `0 0 16px rgba(255, 79, 179, 0.65)`.\n  - Motion: `1.8s` linear infinite oscillation. When reduced motion is preferred, shifts to a gentle `1.2s` opacity pulse.\n\n### Glass TabBar\n- Floating bottom dock: Height `84px` to `88px` (inclusive of safe area margins), surface `rgba(10, 14, 30, 0.72)` with `20px` material blur.\n- Structural boundary: 1px top hairline `rgba(173, 195, 255, 0.18)` without bottom/side borders.\n- **Active Route Indicator:** Rounded pill halo (`rgba(124, 255, 234, 0.12)`) anchoring the active icon, with the icon and label tinted in Electric Cyan (`#7CFFEA`). Idle icons rest in `#A8B0D4` at `65%` opacity.\n\n### Form Inputs & Toggles\n- **Glass Text Input:** Height `52px`, `16px` radius, filled with `rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05)`. Active focus transitions border to `#7CFFEA` with a matching `0 0 12px rgba(124, 255, 234, 0.25)` halo.\n- **Toggle Card:** Min-height `84px`, `20px` radius. Features a glass row background. The active switch state displays an Electric Cyan thumb track accented by a subtle Neon Magenta halo edge.",

  (function() {
    const shareBtn = document.getElementById('shareBtn');
    const toast = document.getElementById('shareFeedback');
    if (shareBtn && toast) {
      shareBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
        toast.classList.remove('opacity-0', 'pointer-events-none');
        toast.classList.add('opacity-100');
        setTimeout(() => {
          toast.classList.remove('opacity-100');
          toast.classList.add('opacity-0', 'pointer-events-none');
        }, 2200);
      });
    }
  })();

      "styleGuidelines": "## Brand & Style\n\nThis design system defines an AI-powered screenshot utility that bridges media capture and calendar scheduling through a glass-tech interface. The visual language balances high-velocity utility with cinematic depth, transforming chaotic on-screen captures into structured temporal actions.\n\n### Design Movements & Tone\n- **Atmospheric Glassmorphism:** Heavy reliance on optical multi-layering, translucent surfaces, specularity, and frosted backdrop blurs (`20px` to `24px`). Surfaces mimic precision-milled optical glass panels suspended in a dark vacuum.\n- **Cinematic Futurism & Neon Precision:** Laser-like scanning beams, neon cyan tiles, and warm laser bursts provide targeted points of interactive energy without cluttering information density.\n- **Tone Matrix:** Focused, dependable, frictionless, and intelligent. The UI avoids playful cartoonishness and sterile monochrome minimalism, balancing engineered precision with responsive visual feedback.\n\n## Layout & Spacing\n\nLayouts follow a fluid, device-aware single-column structure for mobile viewports, expanding to a balanced multi-column modular grid on larger screens.\n\n### Spatial Rhythms\n- **Canvas Margins:** Mobile viewports strictly maintain `16px` (`margin: 1rem`) horizontal outer margins. iPads and large display formats expand to `24px` (`margin-tablet: 1.5rem`).\n- **Vertical Hierarchy:**\n  - Micro-element spacing (icon-to-text, chip gaps): `4px` to `8px` (`space-xs` to `space-sm`).\n  - Card internal padding: `20px` (`space-lg`) on mobile; `24px` (`space-xl`) on expanded cards.\n  - Inter-card flow: `16px` to `20px` (`space-md` to `space-lg`).\n  - Section-to-section separation: `32px` (`space-xxl`).\n- **iOS Safe Areas:** Pinned navigation components factor in hardware constraints: top headers offset by `54pt` for the Dynamic Island; bottom sheets and floating toolbars account for the `34pt` home indicator.\n\n## Elevation & Depth\n\nVisual hierarchy uses physical optics, layered refraction, and multi-tone rims rather than standard drop shadows.\n\n### The Optical Glass Model\n1. **Level 0 (Canvas):** Solid background in Deep Midnight Navy (`#050816`).\n2. **Level 1 (Subtle Inset / Inactive Track):** `rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05)` to `0.08` fill without blur for inactive pills and segmented controls.\n3. **Level 2 (Translucent Glass Paneling):** Applied to ActionCards, DateBadges, and bottom navigation bars. Fills use `rgba(18, 24, 52, 0.72)` supported by a `20px` to `24px` backdrop blur (`backdrop-filter: blur(20px)`).\n4. **Level 3 (Interactive Floating Sheets & Modals):** Foreground popovers and modal ScanSheets sit over a backdrop scrim (`rgba(4, 8, 22, 0.72)`) with a `30px` Gaussian blur.\n\n### Keyline Specularity & Border Rims\nEvery elevated glass panel uses a dual-edge lighting system:\n- **Base Perimeter Hairline:** A continuous 1px stroke using `rgba(173, 195, 255, 0.18)` provides structural definition against deep canvas backgrounds.\n- **Specular Top-Edge Rim:** An inner top highlight of 1px using `rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.22)` simulates an overhead key light refracting along the bevel of an optical glass sheet.\n- **Focused State Glows:** Selected states project an ambient radial wash of `0 0 20px rgba(124, 255, 234, 0.25)`.\n\n## Components\n\n### Buttons\n- **Primary CTA (\"Add to Calendar\"):** Capsule geometry (`28px` radius), height `56px`. Filled with solid Electric Cyan (`#7CFFEA`), using `#07111F` foreground in Sora/Inter 14px SemiBold. Emits a subtle cyan bloom shadow (`0 6px 20px rgba(124, 255, 234, 0.28)`). On touch down, scales to `0.985` over `0.16s`.\n- **Secondary Glass Button:** Translucent fill `rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08)`, 1px perimeter border `rgba(173, 195, 255, 0.18)`, top highlight `rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.22)`. Typography in `#F7F8FF`. Touch state increases background opacity to `0.14`.\n- **Destructive / Dismiss Button:** Low-profile ghost pill with transparent base and `#FF6B7A` text; active state reveals an ambient `rgba(255, 107, 122, 0.12)` fill.\n\n### ActionCard (Extracted Event Tile)\n- Translucent obsidian glass panel (`rgba(18, 24, 52, 0.72)`) with `24px` radius, `20px` internal padding, and `24px` backdrop blur.\n- Dual-edge lighting: 1px `rgba(173, 195, 255, 0.18)` perimeter border plus a 1px top highlight `rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.22)`.\n- **Internal Layout:** Horizontal leading lockup housing the 56x68px `DateBadge`, stacked middle block holding the event title (20px Sora SemiBold) and event time/location (14px Inter Regular in `#A8B0D4`), and trailing confidence pill.\n\n### DateBadge\n- Compact temporal anchor: `56px` wide by `68px` tall, `16px` corner radius.\n- Centered vertical stack: Month string in 11px Sora SemiBold uppercase (`#A8B0D4`), Day integer in 20px Sora Bold (`#F7F8FF`).\n- Border treatment matches the parent ActionCard. Active/selected state introduces a subtle cyan keyline rim glow.\n\n### Confidence Pills\n- Height: `24px`, capsule geometry (`9999px`), internal horizontal padding `10px`.\n- Layout: 12px semantic icon + 11px Sora SemiBold text tracking the confidence score.\n- **High (90%+):** Surface `rgba(70, 227, 154, 0.14)`, border `1px solid rgba(70, 227, 154, 0.40)`, text `#46E39A`.\n- **Medium (60%-89%):** Surface `rgba(255, 190, 85, 0.14)`, border `1px solid rgba(255, 190, 85, 0.40)`, text `#FFBE55`.\n- **Low (<60%):** Surface `rgba(255, 107, 122, 0.14)`, border `1px solid rgba(255, 107, 122, 0.40)`, text `#FF6B7A`.\n\n### ScanSheet & Beam Motion\n- Native bottom sheet container with `32px` top rounded corners and `30px` backdrop blur.\n- Pinned top edge highlighted by a continuous 1px specular line (`rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.22)`).\n- **The Scan Beam:** A horizontal 2px ray translating vertically over the screenshot capture:\n  - Fill: `linear-gradient(90deg, #FF8A3D 0%, #FF4FB3 48%, #7B61FF 100%)`.\n  - Ambient glow: `0 0 16px rgba(255, 79, 179, 0.65)`.\n  - Motion: `1.8s` linear infinite oscillation. When reduced motion is preferred, shifts to a gentle `1.2s` opacity pulse.\n\n### Glass TabBar\n- Floating bottom dock: Height `84px` to `88px` (inclusive of safe area margins), surface `rgba(10, 14, 30, 0.72)` with `20px` material blur.\n- Structural boundary: 1px top hairline `rgba(173, 195, 255, 0.18)` without bottom/side borders.\n- **Active Route Indicator:** Rounded pill halo (`rgba(124, 255, 234, 0.12)`) anchoring the active icon, with the icon and label tinted in Electric Cyan (`#7CFFEA`). Idle icons rest in `#A8B0D4` at `65%` opacity.\n\n### Form Inputs & Toggles\n- **Glass Text Input:** Height `52px`, `16px` radius, filled with `rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05)`. Active focus transitions border to `#7CFFEA` with a matching `0 0 12px rgba(124, 255, 234, 0.25)` halo.\n- **Toggle Card:** Min-height `84px`, `20px` radius. Features a glass row background. The active switch state displays an Electric Cyan thumb track accented by a subtle Neon Magenta halo edge.",

0.25rem\n  space-sm: 0.5rem\n  space-md: 1rem\n  space-lg: 1.25rem\n  space-xl: 1.5rem\n  space-xxl: 2rem\n---\n\n## Brand & Style\n\nThis design system defines an AI-powered screenshot utility that bridges media capture and calendar scheduling through a glass-tech interface. The visual language balances high-velocity utility with cinematic depth, transforming chaotic on-screen captures into structured temporal actions.\n\n### Design Movements & Tone\n- **Atmospheric Glassmorphism:** Heavy reliance on optical multi-layering, translucent surfaces, specularity, and frosted backdrop blurs (`20px` to `24px`). Surfaces mimic precision-milled optical glass panels suspended in a dark vacuum.\n- **Cinematic Futurism & Neon Precision:** Laser-like scanning beams, neon cyan tiles, and warm laser bursts provide targeted points of interactive energy without cluttering information density.\n- **Tone Matrix:** Focused, dependable, frictionless, and intelligent. The UI avoids playful cartoonishness and sterile monochrome minimalism, balancing engineered precision with responsive visual feedback.\n\n## Colors\n\nThe palette operates natively in Apple **Display P3** wide color space, with fallback to sRGB. The dark-first palette uses midnight navy (`#050816`) instead of pure black (`#000000`) to preserve dimensional separation between the canvas and layered glass surfaces.\n\n### Core Architecture\n- **Primary (`#7CFFEA`):** Derived from the vibrant cyan key tile. Used for active confirmations, high-confidence bounding tags, focused toggles, and primary CTA capsules. Text/icons on solid primary fills use `#07111F`.\n- **Secondary (`#5B7CFF`):** Vibrant indigo used for persistent navigation accents, active tab markers, and cool ambient backdrop undertones.\n- **Tertiary (`#FF4FB3`):** High-energy neon magenta that acts as the scan core and celebration hue. Paired with thermal orange (`#FF8A3D`) in dynamic scan beams.\n- **Neutral (`#050816`):** Deep oceanic navy canvas serving as the ground foundation across all primary screens.\n\n### Signature Gradients\n- **Scan Beam Gradient:** `linear-gradient(90deg, #FF8A3D 0%, #FF4FB3 48%, #7B61FF 100%)` for OCR sweeping animations and processing bars.\n- **Brand Aurora Gradient:** `linear-gradient(135deg, #32C5FF 0%, #5B7CFF 30%, #9D4DFF 62%, #FF4FB3 82%, #FF8A3D 100%)` for hero milestone surfaces and primary action badges.\n\n### Color Rules & Hierarchy\n- Limit bright gradient sweeps and saturated glows to a single dominant focal point per viewport.\n- Never place raw `#F7F8FF` text directly over unclamped linear gradients; provide a translucent `#050816` or `rgba(18, 24, 52, 0.72)` glass barrier to preserve WCAG AA contrast.\n\n## Typography\n\nThe typographic hierarchy pairs the geometric personality of **Sora** with the neutral legibility of **Inter** (or Apple system **SF Pro** in native compilation).\n\n### Structural Roles\n- **Sora (Display & Metrics):** Applied across all structural anchors\u2014large screen headings, hero extraction stats, DateBadge calendar numerals, and uppercase metric tags. The tight geometric apertures provide technical authority.\n- **Inter / SF Pro (UI & Parsing Engine):** Applied to narrative event descriptions, interactive button labels, input fields, and timestamps.\n- **11px Overlines:** Strictly transformed to uppercase with positive letter tracking (`+0.04em`) to establish visual landmarks without pulling weight away from primary event titles.\n- **Input Scaling:** Standard body inputs are locked to a minimum `16px` to prevent viewport auto-zooming on mobile web and iOS Safari views.\n\n## Layout & Spacing\n\nLayouts follow a fluid, device-aware single-column structure for mobile viewports, expanding to a balanced multi-column modular grid on larger screens.\n\n### Spatial Rhythms\n- **Canvas Margins:** Mobile viewports strictly maintain `16px` (`margin: 1rem`) horizontal outer margins. iPads and large display formats expand to `24px` (`margin-tablet: 1.5rem`).\n- **Vertical Hierarchy:**\n  - Micro-element spacing (icon-to-text, chip gaps): `4px` to `8px` (`space-xs` to `space-sm`).\n  - Card internal padding: `20px` (`space-lg`) on mobile; `24px` (`space-xl`) on expanded cards.\n  - Inter-card flow: `16px` to `20px` (`space-md` to `space-lg`).\n  - Section-to-section separation: `32px` (`space-xxl`).\n- **iOS Safe Areas:** Pinned navigation components factor in hardware constraints: top headers offset by `54pt` for the Dynamic Island; bottom sheets and floating toolbars account for the `34pt` home indicator.\n\n## Elevation & Depth\n\nVisual hierarchy uses physical optics, layered refraction, and multi-tone rims rather than standard drop shadows.\n\n### The Optical Glass Model\n1. **Level 0 (Canvas):** Solid background in Deep Midnight Navy (`#050816`).\n2. **Level 1 (Subtle Inset / Inactive Track):** `rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05)` to `0.08` fill without blur for inactive pills and segmented controls.\n3. **Level 2 (Translucent Glass Paneling):** Applied to ActionCards, DateBadges, and bottom navigation bars. Fills use `rgba(18, 24, 52, 0.72)` supported by a `20px` to `24px` backdrop blur (`backdrop-filter: blur(20px)`).\n4. **Level 3 (Interactive Floating Sheets & Modals):** Foreground popovers and modal ScanSheets sit over a backdrop scrim (`rgba(4, 8, 22, 0.72)`) with a `30px` Gaussian blur.\n\n### Keyline Specularity & Border Rims\nEvery elevated glass panel uses a dual-edge lighting system:\n- **Base Perimeter Hairline:** A continuous 1px stroke using `rgba(173, 195, 255, 0.18)` provides structural definition against deep canvas backgrounds.\n- **Specular Top-Edge Rim:** An inner top highlight of 1px using `rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.22)` simulates an overhead key light refracting along the bevel of an optical glass sheet.\n- **Focused State Glows:** Selected states project an ambient radial wash of `0 0 20px rgba(124, 255, 234, 0.25)`.\n\n## Shapes\n\nThe shape system balances structural clarity with rounded glass ergonomics. Interactive components use higher radii to provide tactile touch targets.\n\n### Radius Assignments\n- **DateBadges & Confidence Chips:** `16px` radius (`rounded-lg`).\n- **Toggle Cards & Text Inputs:** `16px` to `20px` radius.\n- **ActionCards:** `24px` radius (`rounded-xl`).\n- **Hero Display Panels:** `26px` radius.\n- **CTA Action Buttons:** `28px` radius (producing continuous capsules at 56px heights).\n- **ScanSheets (Bottom Sheets):** `32px` radius along top leading corners.\n- **Confidence Pills & Status Badges:** `9999px` (full capsule).\n\n## Components\n\n### Buttons\n- **Primary CTA (\"Add to Calendar\"):** Capsule geometry (`28px` radius), height `56px`. Filled with solid Electric Cyan (`#7CFFEA`), using `#07111F` foreground in Sora/Inter 14px SemiBold. Emits a subtle cyan bloom shadow (`0 6px 20px rgba(124, 255, 234, 0.28)`). On touch down, scales to `0.985` over `0.16s`.\n- **Secondary Glass Button:** Translucent fill `rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08)`, 1px perimeter border `rgba(173, 195, 255, 0.18)`, top highlight `rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.22)`. Typography in `#F7F8FF`. Touch state increases background opacity to `0.14`.\n- **Destructive / Dismiss Button:** Low-profile ghost pill with transparent base and `#FF6B7A` text; active state reveals an ambient `rgba(255, 107, 122, 0.12)` fill.\n\n### ActionCard (Extracted Event Tile)\n- Translucent obsidian glass panel (`rgba(18, 24, 52, 0.72)`) with `24px` radius, `20px` internal padding, and `24px` backdrop blur.\n- Dual-edge lighting: 1px `rgba(173, 195, 255, 0.18)` perimeter border plus a 1px top highlight `rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.22)`.\n- **Internal Layout:** Horizontal leading lockup housing the 56x68px `DateBadge`, stacked middle block holding the event title (20px Sora SemiBold) and event time/location (14px Inter Regular in `#A8B0D4`), and trailing confidence pill.\n\n### DateBadge\n- Compact temporal anchor: `56px` wide by `68px` tall, `16px` corner radius.\n- Centered vertical stack: Month string in 11px Sora SemiBold uppercase (`#A8B0D4`), Day integer in 20px Sora Bold (`#F7F8FF`).\n- Border treatment matches the parent ActionCard. Active/selected state introduces a subtle cyan keyline rim glow.\n\n### Confidence Pills\n- Height: `24px`, capsule geometry (`9999px`), internal horizontal padding `10px`.\n- Layout: 12px semantic icon + 11px Sora SemiBold text tracking the confidence score.\n- **High (90%+):** Surface `rgba(70, 227, 154, 0.14)`, border `1px solid rgba(70, 227, 154, 0.40)`, text `#46E39A`.\n- **Medium (60%-89%):** Surface `rgba(255, 190, 85, 0.14)`, border `1px solid rgba(255, 190, 85, 0.40)`, text `#FFBE55`.\n- **Low (<60%):** Surface `rgba(255, 107, 122, 0.14)`, border `1px solid rgba(255, 107, 122, 0.40)`, text `#FF6B7A`.\n\n### ScanSheet & Beam Motion\n- Native bottom sheet container with `32px` top rounded corners and `30px` backdrop blur.\n- Pinned top edge highlighted by a continuous 1px specular line (`rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.22)`).\n- **The Scan Beam:** A horizontal 2px ray translating vertically over the screenshot capture:\n  - Fill: `linear-gradient(90deg, #FF8A3D 0%, #FF4FB3 48%, #7B61FF 100%)`.\n  - Ambient glow: `0 0 16px rgba(255, 79, 179, 0.65)`.\n  - Motion: `1.8s` linear infinite oscillation. When reduced motion is preferred, shifts to a gentle `1.2s` opacity pulse.\n\n### Glass TabBar\n- Floating bottom dock: Height `84px` to `88px` (inclusive of safe area margins), surface `rgba(10, 14, 30, 0.72)` with `20px` material blur.\n- Structural boundary: 1px top hairline `rgba(173, 195, 255, 0.18)` without bottom/side borders.\n- **Active Route Indicator:** Rounded pill halo (`rgba(124, 255, 234, 0.12)`) anchoring the active icon, with the icon and label tinted in Electric Cyan (`#7CFFEA`). Idle icons rest in `#A8B0D4` at `65%` opacity.\n\n### Form Inputs & Toggles\n- **Glass Text Input:** Height `52px`, `16px` radius, filled with `rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05)`. Active focus transitions border to `#7CFFEA` with a matching `0 0 12px rgba(124, 255, 234, 0.25)` halo.\n- **Toggle Card:** Min-height `84px`, `20px` radius. Features a glass row background. <script>
  // Toggle Source Preview
  const toggleBtn = document.getElementById('toggle-source-preview-btn');
  const previewDrawer = document.getElementById('source-preview-drawer');
  if (toggleBtn && previewDrawer) {
    toggleBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
      previewDrawer.classList.toggle('hidden');
    });
  }

  // Raw OCR Accordion Toggle
  const ocrTrigger = document.getElementById('raw-ocr-trigger');
  const ocrContent = document.getElementById('raw-ocr-content');
  const ocrChevron = document.getElementById('raw-ocr-chevron');
  if (ocrTrigger && ocrContent && ocrChevron) {
    ocrTrigger.addEventListener('click', () => {
      const isHidden = ocrContent.classList.toggle('hidden');
      ocrChevron.style.transform = isHidden ? 'rotate(0deg)' : 'rotate(180deg)';
    });
  }

  // All Day Toggle Switch Micro-interaction
  const allDayBtn = document.getElementById('all-day-toggle');
  const toggleThumb = document.getElementById('toggle-thumb');
  let isAllDay = false;
  if (allDayBtn && toggleThumb) {
    allDayBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
      isAllDay = !isAllDay;
      allDayBtn.setAttribute('aria-checked', isAllDay.toString());
      if (isAllDay) {
        allDayBtn.classList.remove('bg-surface-container-high');
        allDayBtn.classList.add('bg-primary-container', 'shadow-[0_0_12px_rgba(116,248,227,0.4)]');
        toggleThumb.classList.remove('bg-muted-foreground', 'translate-x-0');
        toggleThumb.classList.add('bg-primary-foreground', 'translate-x-5');
      } else {
        allDayBtn.classList.add('bg-surface-container-high');
        allDayBtn.classList.remove('bg-primary-container', 'shadow-[0_0_12px_rgba(116,248,227,0.4)]');
        toggleThumb.classList.add('bg-muted-foreground', 'translate-x-0');
        toggleThumb.classList.remove('bg-primary-foreground', 'translate-x-5');
      }
    });
  }

  // Save Event Button Feedback & Toast
  const saveBtn = document.getElementById('save-event-btn');
  const toast = document.getElementById('toast-success');
  if (saveBtn && toast) {
    saveBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
      saveBtn.innerHTML = '<span class="material-symbols-outlined animate-spin text-[20px]">sync</span><span>Syncing...</span>';
      saveBtn.disabled = true;
      setTimeout(() => {
        saveBtn.innerHTML = '<span class="material-symbols-outlined text-[20px]">check_circle</span><span>Event Added!</span>';
        toast.classList.remove('translate-y-32');
        toast.classList.add('translate-y-0');
        setTimeout(() => {
          toast.classList.remove('translate-y-0');
          toast.classList.add('translate-y-32');
          saveBtn.disabled = false;
          saveBtn.innerHTML = '<span>Save Event to Calendar</span><span class="material-symbols-outlined text-[20px] font-bold">arrow_forward</span>';
        }, 2600);
      }, 700);
    });
  }
</script></main></body></html>

      "displayName": "Midnight Prism",
      "styleGuidelines": "## Brand & Style\n\nThis design system defines an AI-powered screenshot utility that bridges media capture and calendar scheduling through a glass-tech interface. The visual language balances high-velocity utility with cinematic depth, transforming chaotic on-screen captures into structured temporal actions.\n\n### Design Movements & Tone\n- **Atmospheric Glassmorphism:** Heavy reliance on optical multi-layering, translucent surfaces, specularity, and frosted backdrop blurs (`20px` to `24px`). Surfaces mimic precision-milled optical glass panels suspended in a dark vacuum.\n- **Cinematic Futurism & Neon Precision:** Laser-like scanning beams, neon cyan tiles, and warm laser bursts provide targeted points of interactive energy without cluttering information density.\n- **Tone Matrix:** Focused, dependable, frictionless, and intelligent. The UI avoids playful cartoonishness and sterile monochrome minimalism, balancing engineered precision with responsive visual feedback.\n\n## Layout & Spacing\n\nLayouts follow a fluid, device-aware single-column structure for mobile viewports, expanding to a balanced multi-column modular grid on larger screens.\n\n### Spatial Rhythms\n- **Canvas Margins:** Mobile viewports strictly maintain `16px` (`margin: 1rem`) horizontal outer margins. iPads and large display formats expand to `24px` (`margin-tablet: 1.5rem`).\n- **Vertical Hierarchy:**\n  - Micro-element spacing (icon-to-text, chip gaps): `4px` to `8px` (`space-xs` to `space-sm`).\n  - Card internal padding: `20px` (`space-lg`) on mobile; `24px` (`space-xl`) on expanded cards.\n  - Inter-card flow: `16px` to `20px` (`space-md` to `space-lg`).\n  - Section-to-section separation: `32px` (`space-xxl`).\n- **iOS Safe Areas:** Pinned navigation components factor in hardware constraints: top headers offset by `54pt` for the Dynamic Island; bottom sheets and floating toolbars account for the `34pt` home indicator.\n\n## Elevation & Depth\n\nVisual hierarchy uses physical optics, layered refraction, and multi-tone rims rather than standard drop shadows.\n\n### The Optical Glass Model\n1. **Level 0 (Canvas):** Solid background in Deep Midnight Navy (`#050816`).\n2. **Level 1 (Subtle Inset / Inactive Track):** `rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05)` to `0.08` fill without blur for inactive pills and segmented controls.\n3. **Level 2 (Translucent Glass Paneling):** Applied to ActionCards, DateBadges, and bottom navigation bars. Fills use `rgba(18, 24, 52, 0.72)` supported by a `20px` to `24px` backdrop blur (`backdrop-filter: blur(20px)`).\n4. **Level 3 (Interactive Floating Sheets & Modals):** Foreground popovers and modal ScanSheets sit over a backdrop scrim (`rgba(4, 8, 22, 0.72)`) with a `30px` Gaussian blur.\n\n### Keyline Specularity & Border Rims\nEvery elevated glass panel uses a dual-edge lighting system:\n- **Base Perimeter Hairline:** A continuous 1px stroke using `rgba(173, 195, 255, 0.18)` provides structural definition against deep canvas backgrounds.\n- **Specular Top-Edge Rim:** An inner top highlight of 1px using `rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.22)` simulates an overhead key light refracting along the bevel of an optical glass sheet.\n- **Focused State Glows:** Selected states project an ambient radial wash of `0 0 20px rgba(124, 255, 234, 0.25)`.\n\n## Components\n\n### Buttons\n- **Primary CTA (\"Add to Calendar\"):** Capsule geometry (`28px` radius), height `56px`. Filled with solid Electric Cyan (`#7CFFEA`), using `#07111F` foreground in Sora/Inter 14px SemiBold. Emits a subtle cyan bloom shadow (`0 6px 20px rgba(124, 255, 234, 0.28)`). On touch down, scales to `0.985` over `0.16s`.\n- **Secondary Glass Button:** Translucent fill `rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08)`, 1px perimeter border `rgba(173, 195, 255, 0.18)`, top highlight `rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.22)`. Typography in `#F7F8FF`. Touch state increases background opacity to `0.14`.\n- **Destructive / Dismiss Button:** Low-profile ghost pill with transparent base and `#FF6B7A` text; active state reveals an ambient `rgba(255, 107, 122, 0.12)` fill.\n\n### ActionCard (Extracted Event Tile)\n- Translucent obsidian glass panel (`rgba(18, 24, 52, 0.72)`) with `24px` radius, `20px` internal padding, and `24px` backdrop blur.\n- Dual-edge lighting: 1px `rgba(173, 195, 255, 0.18)` perimeter border plus a 1px top highlight `rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.22)`.\n- **Internal Layout:** Horizontal leading lockup housing the 56x68px `DateBadge`, stacked middle block holding the event title (20px Sora SemiBold) and event time/location (14px Inter Regular in `#A8B0D4`), and trailing confidence pill.\n\n### DateBadge\n- Compact temporal anchor: `56px` wide by `68px` tall, `16px` corner radius.\n- Centered vertical stack: Month string in 11px Sora SemiBold uppercase (`#A8B0D4`), Day integer in 20px Sora Bold (`#F7F8FF`).\n- Border treatment matches the parent ActionCard. Active/selected state introduces a subtle cyan keyline rim glow.\n\n### Confidence Pills\n- Height: `24px`, capsule geometry (`9999px`), internal horizontal padding `10px`.\n- Layout: 12px semantic icon + 11px Sora SemiBold text tracking the confidence score.\n- **High (90%+):** Surface `rgba(70, 227, 154, 0.14)`, border `1px solid rgba(70, 227, 154, 0.40)`, text `#46E39A`.\n- **Medium (60%-89%):** Surface `rgba(255, 190, 85, 0.14)`, border `1px solid rgba(255, 190, 85, 0.40)`, text `#FFBE55`.\n- **Low (<60%):** Surface `rgba(255, 107, 122, 0.14)`, border `1px solid rgba(255, 107, 122, 0.40)`, text `#FF6B7A`.\n\n### ScanSheet & Beam Motion\n- Native bottom sheet container with `32px` top rounded corners and `30px` backdrop blur.\n- Pinned top edge highlighted by a continuous 1px specular line (`rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.22)`).\n- **The Scan Beam:** A horizontal 2px ray translating vertically over the screenshot capture:\n  - Fill: `linear-gradient(90deg, #FF8A3D 0%, #FF4FB3 48%, #7B61FF 100%)`.\n  - Ambient glow: `0 0 16px rgba(255, 79, 179, 0.65)`.\n  - Motion: `1.8s` linear infinite oscillation. When reduced motion is preferred, shifts to a gentle `1.2s` opacity pulse.\n\n### Glass TabBar\n- Floating bottom dock: Height `84px` to `88px` (inclusive of safe area margins), surface `rgba(10, 14, 30, 0.72)` with `20px` material blur.\n- Structural boundary: 1px top hairline `rgba(173, 195, 255, 0.18)` without bottom/side borders.\n- **Active Route Indicator:** Rounded pill halo (`rgba(124, 255, 234, 0.12)`) anchoring the active icon, with the icon and label tinted in Electric Cyan (`#7CFFEA`). Idle icons rest in `#A8B0D4` at `65%` opacity.\n\n### Form Inputs & Toggles\n- **Glass Text Input:** Height `52px`, `16px` radius, filled with `rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05)`. Active focus transitions border to `#7CFFEA` with a matching `0 0 12px rgba(124, 255, 234, 0.25)` halo.\n- **Toggle Card:** Min-height `84px`, `20px` radius. Features a glass row background. 0.25rem\n  space-sm: 0.5rem\n  space-md: 1rem\n  space-lg: 1.25rem\n  space-xl: 1.5rem\n  space-xxl: 2rem\n---\n\n## Brand & Style\n\nThis design system defines an AI-powered screenshot utility that bridges media capture and calendar scheduling through a glass-tech interface. The visual language balances high-velocity utility with cinematic depth, transforming chaotic on-screen captures into structured temporal actions.\n\n### Design Movements & Tone\n- **Atmospheric Glassmorphism:** Heavy reliance on optical multi-layering, translucent surfaces, specularity, and frosted backdrop blurs (`20px` to `24px`). Surfaces mimic precision-milled optical glass panels suspended in a dark vacuum.\n- **Cinematic Futurism & Neon Precision:** Laser-like scanning beams, neon cyan tiles, and warm laser bursts provide targeted points of interactive energy without cluttering information density.\n- **Tone Matrix:** Focused, dependable, frictionless, and intelligent. The UI avoids playful cartoonishness and sterile monochrome minimalism, balancing engineered precision with responsive visual feedback.\n\n## Colors\n\nThe palette operates natively in Apple **Display P3** wide color space, with fallback to sRGB. The dark-first palette uses midnight navy (`#050816`) instead of pure black (`#000000`) to preserve dimensional separation between the canvas and layered glass surfaces.\n\n### Core Architecture\n- **Primary (`#7CFFEA`):** Derived from the vibrant cyan key tile. Used for active confirmations, high-confidence bounding tags, focused toggles, and primary CTA capsules. Text/icons on solid primary fills use `#07111F`.\n- **Secondary (`#5B7CFF`):** Vibrant indigo used for persistent navigation accents, active tab markers, and cool ambient backdrop undertones.\n- **Tertiary (`#FF4FB3`):** High-energy neon magenta that acts as the scan core and celebration hue. Paired with thermal orange (`#FF8A3D`) in dynamic scan beams.\n- **Neutral (`#050816`):** Deep oceanic navy canvas serving as the ground foundation across all primary screens.\n\n### Signature Gradients\n- **Scan Beam Gradient:** `linear-gradient(90deg, #FF8A3D 0%, #FF4FB3 48%, #7B61FF 100%)` for OCR sweeping animations and processing bars.\n- **Brand Aurora Gradient:** `linear-gradient(135deg, #32C5FF 0%, #5B7CFF 30%, #9D4DFF 62%, #FF4FB3 82%, #FF8A3D 100%)` for hero milestone surfaces and primary action badges.\n\n### Color Rules & Hierarchy\n- Limit bright gradient sweeps and saturated glows to a single dominant focal point per viewport.\n- Never place raw `#F7F8FF` text directly over unclamped linear gradients; provide a translucent `#050816` or `rgba(18, 24, 52, 0.72)` glass barrier to preserve WCAG AA contrast.\n\n## Typography\n\nThe typographic hierarchy pairs the geometric personality of **Sora** with the neutral legibility of **Inter** (or Apple system **SF Pro** in native compilation).\n\n### Structural Roles\n- **Sora (Display & Metrics):** Applied across all structural anchors\u2014large screen headings, hero extraction stats, DateBadge calendar numerals, and uppercase metric tags. The tight geometric apertures provide technical authority.\n- **Inter / SF Pro (UI & Parsing Engine):** Applied to narrative event descriptions, interactive button labels, input fields, and timestamps.\n- **11px Overlines:** Strictly transformed to uppercase with positive letter tracking (`+0.04em`) to establish visual landmarks without pulling weight away from primary event titles.\n- **Input Scaling:** Standard body inputs are locked to a minimum `16px` to prevent viewport auto-zooming on mobile web and iOS Safari views.\n\n## Layout & Spacing\n\nLayouts follow a fluid, device-aware single-column structure for mobile viewports, expanding to a balanced multi-column modular grid on larger screens.\n\n### Spatial Rhythms\n- **Canvas Margins:** Mobile viewports strictly maintain `16px` (`margin: 1rem`) horizontal outer margins. iPads and large display formats expand to `24px` (`margin-tablet: 1.5rem`).\n- **Vertical Hierarchy:**\n  - Micro-element spacing (icon-to-text, chip gaps): `4px` to `8px` (`space-xs` to `space-sm`).\n  - Card internal padding: `20px` (`space-lg`) on mobile; `24px` (`space-xl`) on expanded cards.\n  - Inter-card flow: `16px` to `20px` (`space-md` to `space-lg`).\n  - Section-to-section separation: `32px` (`space-xxl`).\n- **iOS Safe Areas:** Pinned navigation components factor in hardware constraints: top headers offset by `54pt` for the Dynamic Island; bottom sheets and floating toolbars account for the `34pt` home indicator.\n\n## Elevation & Depth\n\nVisual hierarchy uses physical optics, layered refraction, and multi-tone rims rather than standard drop shadows.\n\n### The Optical Glass Model\n1. **Level 0 (Canvas):** Solid background in Deep Midnight Navy (`#050816`).\n2. **Level 1 (Subtle Inset / Inactive Track):** `rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05)` to `0.08` fill without blur for inactive pills and segmented controls.\n3. **Level 2 (Translucent Glass Paneling):** Applied to ActionCards, DateBadges, and bottom navigation bars. Fills use `rgba(18, 24, 52, 0.72)` supported by a `20px` to `24px` backdrop blur (`backdrop-filter: blur(20px)`).\n4. **Level 3 (Interactive Floating Sheets & Modals):** Foreground popovers and modal ScanSheets sit over a backdrop scrim (`rgba(4, 8, 22, 0.72)`) with a `30px` Gaussian blur.\n\n### Keyline Specularity & Border Rims\nEvery elevated glass panel uses a dual-edge lighting system:\n- **Base Perimeter Hairline:** A continuous 1px stroke using `rgba(173, 195, 255, 0.18)` provides structural definition against deep canvas backgrounds.\n- **Specular Top-Edge Rim:** An inner top highlight of 1px using `rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.22)` simulates an overhead key light refracting along the bevel of an optical glass sheet.\n- **Focused State Glows:** Selected states project an ambient radial wash of `0 0 20px rgba(124, 255, 234, 0.25)`.\n\n## Shapes\n\nThe shape system balances structural clarity with rounded glass ergonomics. Interactive components use higher radii to provide tactile touch targets.\n\n### Radius Assignments\n- **DateBadges & Confidence Chips:** `16px` radius (`rounded-lg`).\n- **Toggle Cards & Text Inputs:** `16px` to `20px` radius.\n- **ActionCards:** `24px` radius (`rounded-xl`).\n- **Hero Display Panels:** `26px` radius.\n- **CTA Action Buttons:** `28px` radius (producing continuous capsules at 56px heights).\n- **ScanSheets (Bottom Sheets):** `32px` radius along top leading corners.\n- **Confidence Pills & Status Badges:** `9999px` (full capsule).\n\n## Components\n\n### Buttons\n- **Primary CTA (\"Add to Calendar\"):** Capsule geometry (`28px` radius), height `56px`. Filled with solid Electric Cyan (`#7CFFEA`), using `#07111F` foreground in Sora/Inter 14px SemiBold. Emits a subtle cyan bloom shadow (`0 6px 20px rgba(124, 255, 234, 0.28)`). On touch down, scales to `0.985` over `0.16s`.\n- **Secondary Glass Button:** Translucent fill `rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08)`, 1px perimeter border `rgba(173, 195, 255, 0.18)`, top highlight `rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.22)`. Typography in `#F7F8FF`. Touch state increases background opacity to `0.14`.\n- **Destructive / Dismiss Button:** Low-profile ghost pill with transparent base and `#FF6B7A` text; active state reveals an ambient `rgba(255, 107, 122, 0.12)` fill.\n\n### ActionCard (Extracted Event Tile)\n- Translucent obsidian glass panel (`rgba(18, 24, 52, 0.72)`) with `24px` radius, `20px` internal padding, and `24px` backdrop blur.\n- Dual-edge lighting: 1px `rgba(173, 195, 255, 0.18)` perimeter border plus a 1px top highlight `rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.22)`.\n- **Internal Layout:** Horizontal leading lockup housing the 56x68px `DateBadge`, stacked middle block holding the event title (20px Sora SemiBold) and event time/location (14px Inter Regular in `#A8B0D4`), and trailing confidence pill.\n\n### DateBadge\n- Compact temporal anchor: `56px` wide by `68px` tall, `16px` corner radius.\n- Centered vertical stack: Month string in 11px Sora SemiBold uppercase (`#A8B0D4`), Day integer in 20px Sora Bold (`#F7F8FF`).\n- Border treatment matches the parent ActionCard. <script>
  let activeAlerts = [1, 2, 3];

  function updateAddButtonState() {
    const btn = document.getElementById('addAlertBtn');
    const label = document.getElementById('addAlertBtnLabel');
    if (!btn || !label) return;

    if (activeAlerts.length >= 3) {
      btn.classList.add('opacity-60', 'cursor-not-allowed');
      btn.classList.remove('bg-surface-container', 'text-foreground-primary', 'cursor-pointer');
      label.textContent = 'Alert Limit Reached (3 of 3 max)';
    } else {
      btn.classList.remove('opacity-60', 'cursor-not-allowed');
      btn.classList.add('bg-surface-container', 'text-foreground-primary', 'cursor-pointer');
      label.textContent = `+ Add Alert (${activeAlerts.length} of 3 active)`;
    }
  }

  function deleteReminder(id) {
    const card = document.getElementById('reminder-row-' + id);
    if (!card) return;

    card.classList.add('scale-95', 'opacity-0');
    setTimeout(() => {
      card.remove();
      activeAlerts = activeAlerts.filter(item => item !== id);
      updateAddButtonState();
    }, 200);
  }

  function handleAddAlert() {
    if (activeAlerts.length >= 3) return;

    const availableIds = [1, 2, 3].filter(id => !activeAlerts.includes(id));
    if (availableIds.length === 0) return;

    const newId = availableIds[0];
    const container = document.getElementById('reminderCardContainer');

    const card = document.createElement('div');
    card.className = 'reminder-row group relative bg-card-glass backdrop-blur-2xl rounded-2xl p-space-md shadow-lg transition-all scale-95 opacity-0';
    card.id = `reminder-row-${newId}`;

    card.innerHTML = `
      <div class="flex items-start justify-between gap-space-sm">
        <div class="flex items-center gap-space-sm">
          <div class="w-10 h-10 rounded-xl bg-status-info/20 flex items-center justify-center text-status-info shadow-inner">
            <span class="material-symbols-outlined text-[20px]">alarm</span>
          </div>
          <div>
            <div class="flex items-center gap-space-xs">
              <span class="font-overline-confidence text-overline-confidence text-muted-foreground uppercase">Alert ${newId} &middot; Proximity</span>
            </div>
            <h3 class="font-headline-card text-headline-card text-foreground-primary mt-0.5">
              15 minutes before
            </h3>
          </div>
        </div>
        <button onclick="deleteReminder(${newId})" aria-label="Delete alert ${newId}" class="w-9 h-9 rounded-full bg-muted-surface flex items-center justify-center text-muted-foreground hover:text-status-error active:scale-90 transition-all">
          <span class="material-symbols-outlined text-[18px]">delete</span>
        </button>
      </div>
      <div class="mt-space-md pt-space-sm bg-surface-container-lowest/60 rounded-xl p-space-sm flex flex-col gap-space-sm">
        <div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
          <span class="font-caption text-caption text-muted-foreground flex items-center gap-1">
            <span class="material-symbols-outlined text-[15px] text-secondary">schedule</span> Scheduled for
          </span>
          <span class="font-label-chip text-label-chip text-foreground-primary bg-surface-container-high px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg">
            Jul 18, 6:45 PM
          </span>
        </div>
        <div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
          <span class="font-caption text-caption text-muted-foreground flex items-center gap-1">
            <span class="material-symbols-outlined text-[15px] text-secondary">notifications_active</span> Channel
          </span>
          <div class="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full bg-primary-container/20 text-primary-fixed font-label-chip text-label-chip">
            <span class="material-symbols-outlined text-[14px]">notifications</span>
            <span>Push Notification</span>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    `;

    container.appendChild(card);
    activeAlerts.push(newId);
    updateAddButtonState();

    requestAnimationFrame(() => {
      card.classList.remove('scale-95', 'opacity-0');
      card.classList.add('scale-100', 'opacity-100');
    });
  }

  function applyPreset(element, presetKey) {
    document.querySelectorAll('.preset-pill').forEach(btn => {
      btn.className = 'preset-pill flex-shrink-0 flex items-center gap-1.5 px-4 py-2.5 rounded-full bg-card-glass text-foreground-primary font-label-chip text-label-chip backdrop-blur-xl shadow-sm transition-all active:scale-95';
    });

    element.className = 'preset-pill flex-shrink-0 flex items-center gap-1.5 px-4 py-2.5 rounded-full bg-primary-container text-primary-foreground font-label-chip text-label-chip shadow-md transition-all active:scale-95';

    if (presetKey === 'dayof') {
      if (document.getElementById('reminder-row-1')) deleteReminder(1);
    }
  }

  function resetDefaults() {
    location.reload();
  }

  function saveSchedule() {
    const saveBtn = document.getElementById('saveBtn');
    if (!saveBtn) return;
    const initialText = saveBtn.innerHTML;

    saveBtn.innerHTML = `
      <span class="material-symbols-outlined text-[20px] animate-spin">sync</span>
      <span>Syncing Schedule...</span>
    `;

    setTimeout(() => {
      saveBtn.innerHTML = `
        <span class="material-symbols-outlined text-[20px]">task_alt</span>
        <span>Schedule Synced!</span>
      `;
      saveBtn.classList.replace('bg-primary-container', 'bg-status-success');
      saveBtn.classList.replace('text-primary-foreground', 'text-status-success-foreground');

      setTimeout(() => {
        saveBtn.innerHTML = initialText;
        saveBtn.classList.replace('bg-status-success', 'bg-primary-container');
        saveBtn.classList.replace('text-status-success-foreground', 'text-primary-foreground');
      }, 1800);
    }, 600);
  }

  updateAddButtonState();
</script></main></body></html>

      "styleGuidelines": "## Brand & Style\n\nThis design system defines an AI-powered screenshot utility that bridges media capture and calendar scheduling through a glass-tech interface. The visual language balances high-velocity utility with cinematic depth, transforming chaotic on-screen captures into structured temporal actions.\n\n### Design Movements & Tone\n- **Atmospheric Glassmorphism:** Heavy reliance on optical multi-layering, translucent surfaces, specularity, and frosted backdrop blurs (`20px` to `24px`). Surfaces mimic precision-milled optical glass panels suspended in a dark vacuum.\n- **Cinematic Futurism & Neon Precision:** Laser-like scanning beams, neon cyan tiles, and warm laser bursts provide targeted points of interactive energy without cluttering information density.\n- **Tone Matrix:** Focused, dependable, frictionless, and intelligent. The UI avoids playful cartoonishness and sterile monochrome minimalism, balancing engineered precision with responsive visual feedback.\n\n## Layout & Spacing\n\nLayouts follow a fluid, device-aware single-column structure for mobile viewports, expanding to a balanced multi-column modular grid on larger screens.\n\n### Spatial Rhythms\n- **Canvas Margins:** Mobile viewports strictly maintain `16px` (`margin: 1rem`) horizontal outer margins. iPads and large display formats expand to `24px` (`margin-tablet: 1.5rem`).\n- **Vertical Hierarchy:**\n  - Micro-element spacing (icon-to-text, chip gaps): `4px` to `8px` (`space-xs` to `space-sm`).\n  - Card internal padding: `20px` (`space-lg`) on mobile; `24px` (`space-xl`) on expanded cards.\n  - Inter-card flow: `16px` to `20px` (`space-md` to `space-lg`).\n  - Section-to-section separation: `32px` (`space-xxl`).\n- **iOS Safe Areas:** Pinned navigation components factor in hardware constraints: top headers offset by `54pt` for the Dynamic Island; bottom sheets and floating toolbars account for the `34pt` home indicator.\n\n## Elevation & Depth\n\nVisual hierarchy uses physical optics, layered refraction, and multi-tone rims rather than standard drop shadows.\n\n### The Optical Glass Model\n1. **Level 0 (Canvas):** Solid background in Deep Midnight Navy (`#050816`).\n2. **Level 1 (Subtle Inset / Inactive Track):** `rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05)` to `0.08` fill without blur for inactive pills and segmented controls.\n3. **Level 2 (Translucent Glass Paneling):** Applied to ActionCards, DateBadges, and bottom navigation bars. Fills use `rgba(18, 24, 52, 0.72)` supported by a `20px` to `24px` backdrop blur (`backdrop-filter: blur(20px)`).\n4. **Level 3 (Interactive Floating Sheets & Modals):** Foreground popovers and modal ScanSheets sit over a backdrop scrim (`rgba(4, 8, 22, 0.72)`) with a `30px` Gaussian blur.\n\n### Keyline Specularity & Border Rims\nEvery elevated glass panel uses a dual-edge lighting system:\n- **Base Perimeter Hairline:** A continuous 1px stroke using `rgba(173, 195, 255, 0.18)` provides structural definition against deep canvas backgrounds.\n- **Specular Top-Edge Rim:** An inner top highlight of 1px using `rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.22)` simulates an overhead key light refracting along the bevel of an optical glass sheet.\n- **Focused State Glows:** Selected states project an ambient radial wash of `0 0 20px rgba(124, 255, 234, 0.25)`.\n\n## Components\n\n### Buttons\n- **Primary CTA (\"Add to Calendar\"):** Capsule geometry (`28px` radius), height `56px`. Filled with solid Electric Cyan (`#7CFFEA`), using `#07111F` foreground in Sora/Inter 14px SemiBold. Emits a subtle cyan bloom shadow (`0 6px 20px rgba(124, 255, 234, 0.28)`). On touch down, scales to `0.985` over `0.16s`.\n- **Secondary Glass Button:** Translucent fill `rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08)`, 1px perimeter border `rgba(173, 195, 255, 0.18)`, top highlight `rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.22)`. Typography in `#F7F8FF`. Touch state increases background opacity to `0.14`.\n- **Destructive / Dismiss Button:** Low-profile ghost pill with transparent base and `#FF6B7A` text; active state reveals an ambient `rgba(255, 107, 122, 0.12)` fill.\n\n### ActionCard (Extracted Event Tile)\n- Translucent obsidian glass panel (`rgba(18, 24, 52, 0.72)`) with `24px` radius, `20px` internal padding, and `24px` backdrop blur.\n- Dual-edge lighting: 1px `rgba(173, 195, 255, 0.18)` perimeter border plus a 1px top highlight `rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.22)`.\n- **Internal Layout:** Horizontal leading lockup housing the 56x68px `DateBadge`, stacked middle block holding the event title (20px Sora SemiBold) and event time/location (14px Inter Regular in `#A8B0D4`), and trailing confidence pill.\n\n### DateBadge\n- Compact temporal anchor: `56px` wide by `68px` tall, `16px` corner radius.\n- Centered vertical stack: Month string in 11px Sora SemiBold uppercase (`#A8B0D4`), Day integer in 20px Sora Bold (`#F7F8FF`).\n- Border treatment matches the parent ActionCard. Active/selected state introduces a subtle cyan keyline rim glow.\n\n### Confidence Pills\n- Height: `24px`, capsule geometry (`9999px`), internal horizontal padding `10px`.\n- Layout: 12px semantic icon + 11px Sora SemiBold text tracking the confidence score.\n- **High (90%+):** Surface `rgba(70, 227, 154, 0.14)`, border `1px solid rgba(70, 227, 154, 0.40)`, text `#46E39A`.\n- **Medium (60%-89%):** Surface `rgba(255, 190, 85, 0.14)`, border `1px solid rgba(255, 190, 85, 0.40)`, text `#FFBE55`.\n- **Low (<60%):** Surface `rgba(255, 107, 122, 0.14)`, border `1px solid rgba(255, 107, 122, 0.40)`, text `#FF6B7A`.\n\n### ScanSheet & Beam Motion\n- Native bottom sheet container with `32px` top rounded corners and `30px` backdrop blur.\n- Pinned top edge highlighted by a continuous 1px specular line (`rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.22)`).\n- **The Scan Beam:** A horizontal 2px ray translating vertically over the screenshot capture:\n  - Fill: `linear-gradient(90deg, #FF8A3D 0%, #FF4FB3 48%, #7B61FF 100%)`.\n  - Ambient glow: `0 0 16px rgba(255, 79, 179, 0.65)`.\n  - Motion: `1.8s` linear infinite oscillation. When reduced motion is preferred, shifts to a gentle `1.2s` opacity pulse.\n\n### Glass TabBar\n- Floating bottom dock: Height `84px` to `88px` (inclusive of safe area margins), surface `rgba(10, 14, 30, 0.72)` with `20px` material blur.\n- Structural boundary: 1px top hairline `rgba(173, 195, 255, 0.18)` without bottom/side borders.\n- **Active Route Indicator:** Rounded pill halo (`rgba(124, 255, 234, 0.12)`) anchoring the active icon, with the icon and label tinted in Electric Cyan (`#7CFFEA`). Idle icons rest in `#A8B0D4` at `65%` opacity.\n\n### Form Inputs & Toggles\n- **Glass Text Input:** Height `52px`, `16px` radius, filled with `rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05)`. Active focus transitions border to `#7CFFEA` with a matching `0 0 12px rgba(124, 255, 234, 0.25)` halo.\n- **Toggle Card:** Min-height `84px`, `20px` radius. Features a glass row background. The active switch state displays an Electric Cyan thumb track accented by a subtle Neon Magenta halo edge.",

0.25rem\n  space-sm: 0.5rem\n  space-md: 1rem\n  space-lg: 1.25rem\n  space-xl: 1.5rem\n  space-xxl: 2rem\n---\n\n## Brand & Style\n\nThis design system defines an AI-powered screenshot utility that bridges media capture and calendar scheduling through a glass-tech interface. The visual language balances high-velocity utility with cinematic depth, transforming chaotic on-screen captures into structured temporal actions.\n\n### Design Movements & Tone\n- **Atmospheric Glassmorphism:** Heavy reliance on optical multi-layering, translucent surfaces, specularity, and frosted backdrop blurs (`20px` to `24px`). Surfaces mimic precision-milled optical glass panels suspended in a dark vacuum.\n- **Cinematic Futurism & Neon Precision:** Laser-like scanning beams, neon cyan tiles, and warm laser bursts provide targeted points of interactive energy without cluttering information density.\n- **Tone Matrix:** Focused, dependable, frictionless, and intelligent. The UI avoids playful cartoonishness and sterile monochrome minimalism, balancing engineered precision with responsive visual feedback.\n\n## Colors\n\nThe palette operates natively in Apple **Display P3** wide color space, with fallback to sRGB. The dark-first palette uses midnight navy (`#050816`) instead of pure black (`#000000`) to preserve dimensional separation between the canvas and layered glass surfaces.\n\n### Core Architecture\n- **Primary (`#7CFFEA`):** Derived from the vibrant cyan key tile. Used for active confirmations, high-confidence bounding tags, focused toggles, and primary CTA capsules. Text/icons on solid primary fills use `#07111F`.\n- **Secondary (`#5B7CFF`):** Vibrant indigo used for persistent navigation accents, active tab markers, and cool ambient backdrop undertones.\n- **Tertiary (`#FF4FB3`):** High-energy neon magenta that acts as the scan core and celebration hue. Paired with thermal orange (`#FF8A3D`) in dynamic scan beams.\n- **Neutral (`#050816`):** Deep oceanic navy canvas serving as the ground foundation across all primary screens.\n\n### Signature Gradients\n- **Scan Beam Gradient:** `linear-gradient(90deg, #FF8A3D 0%, #FF4FB3 48%, #7B61FF 100%)` for OCR sweeping animations and processing bars.\n- **Brand Aurora Gradient:** `linear-gradient(135deg, #32C5FF 0%, #5B7CFF 30%, #9D4DFF 62%, #FF4FB3 82%, #FF8A3D 100%)` for hero milestone surfaces and primary action badges.\n\n### Color Rules & Hierarchy\n- Limit bright gradient sweeps and saturated glows to a single dominant focal point per viewport.\n- Never place raw `#F7F8FF` text directly over unclamped linear gradients; provide a translucent `#050816` or `rgba(18, 24, 52, 0.72)` glass barrier to preserve WCAG AA contrast.\n\n## Typography\n\nThe typographic hierarchy pairs the geometric personality of **Sora** with the neutral legibility of **Inter** (or Apple system **SF Pro** in native compilation).\n\n### Structural Roles\n- **Sora (Display & Metrics):** Applied across all structural anchors\u2014large screen headings, hero extraction stats, DateBadge calendar numerals, and uppercase metric tags. The tight geometric apertures provide technical authority.\n- **Inter / SF Pro (UI & Parsing Engine):** Applied to narrative event descriptions, interactive button labels, input fields, and timestamps.\n- **11px Overlines:** Strictly transformed to uppercase with positive letter tracking (`+0.04em`) to establish visual landmarks without pulling weight away from primary event titles.\n- **Input Scaling:** Standard body inputs are locked to a minimum `16px` to prevent viewport auto-zooming on mobile web and iOS Safari views.\n\n## Layout & Spacing\n\nLayouts follow a fluid, device-aware single-column structure for mobile viewports, expanding to a balanced multi-column modular grid on larger screens.\n\n### Spatial Rhythms\n- **Canvas Margins:** Mobile viewports strictly maintain `16px` (`margin: 1rem`) horizontal outer margins. iPads and large display formats expand to `24px` (`margin-tablet: 1.5rem`).\n- **Vertical Hierarchy:**\n  - Micro-element spacing (icon-to-text, chip gaps): `4px` to `8px` (`space-xs` to `space-sm`).\n  - Card internal padding: `20px` (`space-lg`) on mobile; `24px` (`space-xl`) on expanded cards.\n  - Inter-card flow: `16px` to `20px` (`space-md` to `space-lg`).\n  - Section-to-section separation: `32px` (`space-xxl`).\n- **iOS Safe Areas:** Pinned navigation components factor in hardware constraints: top headers offset by `54pt` for the Dynamic Island; bottom sheets and floating toolbars account for the `34pt` home indicator.\n\n## Elevation & Depth\n\nVisual hierarchy uses physical optics, layered refraction, and multi-tone rims rather than standard drop shadows.\n\n### The Optical Glass Model\n1. **Level 0 (Canvas):** Solid background in Deep Midnight Navy (`#050816`).\n2. **Level 1 (Subtle Inset / Inactive Track):** `rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05)` to `0.08` fill without blur for inactive pills and segmented controls.\n3. **Level 2 (Translucent Glass Paneling):** Applied to ActionCards, DateBadges, and bottom navigation bars. Fills use `rgba(18, 24, 52, 0.72)` supported by a `20px` to `24px` backdrop blur (`backdrop-filter: blur(20px)`).\n4. **Level 3 (Interactive Floating Sheets & Modals):** Foreground popovers and modal ScanSheets sit over a backdrop scrim (`rgba(4, 8, 22, 0.72)`) with a `30px` Gaussian blur.\n\n### Keyline Specularity & Border Rims\nEvery elevated glass panel uses a dual-edge lighting system:\n- **Base Perimeter Hairline:** A continuous 1px stroke using `rgba(173, 195, 255, 0.18)` provides structural definition against deep canvas backgrounds.\n- **Specular Top-Edge Rim:** An inner top highlight of 1px using `rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.22)` simulates an overhead key light refracting along the bevel of an optical glass sheet.\n- **Focused State Glows:** Selected states project an ambient radial wash of `0 0 20px rgba(124, 255, 234, 0.25)`.\n\n## Shapes\n\nThe shape system balances structural clarity with rounded glass ergonomics. Interactive components use higher radii to provide tactile touch targets.\n\n### Radius Assignments\n- **DateBadges & Confidence Chips:** `16px` radius (`rounded-lg`).\n- **Toggle Cards & Text Inputs:** `16px` to `20px` radius.\n- **ActionCards:** `24px` radius (`rounded-xl`).\n- **Hero Display Panels:** `26px` radius.\n- **CTA Action Buttons:** `28px` radius (producing continuous capsules at 56px heights).\n- **ScanSheets (Bottom Sheets):** `32px` radius along top leading corners.\n- **Confidence Pills & Status Badges:** `9999px` (full capsule).\n\n## Components\n\n### Buttons\n- **Primary CTA (\"Add to Calendar\"):** Capsule geometry (`28px` radius), height `56px`. Filled with solid Electric Cyan (`#7CFFEA`), using `#07111F` foreground in Sora/Inter 14px SemiBold. Emits a subtle cyan bloom shadow (`0 6px 20px rgba(124, 255, 234, 0.28)`). On touch down, scales to `0.985` over `0.16s`.\n- **Secondary Glass Button:** Translucent fill `rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08)`, 1px perimeter border `rgba(173, 195, 255, 0.18)`, top highlight `rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.22)`. Typography in `#F7F8FF`. Touch state increases background opacity to `0.14`.\n- **Destructive / Dismiss Button:** Low-profile ghost pill with transparent base and `#FF6B7A` text; active state reveals an ambient `rgba(255, 107, 122, 0.12)` fill.\n\n### ActionCard (Extracted Event Tile)\n- Translucent obsidian glass panel (`rgba(18, 24, 52, 0.72)`) with `24px` radius, `20px` internal padding, and `24px` backdrop blur.\n- Dual-edge lighting: 1px `rgba(173, 195, 255, 0.18)` perimeter border plus a 1px top highlight `rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.22)`.\n- **Internal Layout:** Horizontal leading lockup housing the 56x68px `DateBadge`, stacked middle block holding the event title (20px Sora SemiBold) and event time/location (14px Inter Regular in `#A8B0D4`), and trailing confidence pill.\n\n### DateBadge\n- Compact temporal anchor: `56px` wide by `68px` tall, `16px` corner radius.\n- Centered vertical stack: Month string in 11px Sora SemiBold uppercase (`#A8B0D4`), Day integer in 20px Sora Bold (`#F7F8FF`).\n- Border treatment matches the parent ActionCard. Active/selected state introduces a subtle cyan keyline rim glow.\n\n### Confidence Pills\n- Height: `24px`, capsule geometry (`9999px`), internal horizontal padding `10px`.\n- Layout: 12px semantic icon + 11px Sora SemiBold text tracking the confidence score.\n- **High (90%+):** Surface `rgba(70, 227, 154, 0.14)`, border `1px solid rgba(70, 227, 154, 0.40)`, text `#46E39A`.\n- **Medium (60%-89%):** Surface `rgba(255, 190, 85, 0.14)`, border `1px solid rgba(255, 190, 85, 0.40)`, text `#FFBE55`.\n- **Low (<60%):** Surface `rgba(255, 107, 122, 0.14)`, border `1px solid rgba(255, 107, 122, 0.40)`, text `#FF6B7A`.\n\n### ScanSheet & Beam Motion\n- Native bottom sheet container with `32px` top rounded corners and `30px` backdrop blur.\n- Pinned top edge highlighted by a continuous 1px specular line (`rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.22)`).\n- **The Scan Beam:** A horizontal 2px ray translating vertically over the screenshot capture:\n  - Fill: `linear-gradient(90deg, #FF8A3D 0%, #FF4FB3 48%, #7B61FF 100%)`.\n  - Ambient glow: `0 0 16px rgba(255, 79, 179, 0.65)`.\n  - Motion: `1.8s` linear infinite oscillation. When reduced motion is preferred, shifts to a gentle `1.2s` opacity pulse.\n\n### Glass TabBar\n- Floating bottom dock: Height `84px` to `88px` (inclusive of safe area margins), surface `rgba(10, 14, 30, 0.72)` with `20px` material blur.\n- Structural boundary: 1px top hairline `rgba(173, 195, 255, 0.18)` without bottom/side borders.\n- **Active Route Indicator:** Rounded pill halo (`rgba(124, 255, 234, 0.12)`) anchoring the active icon, with the icon and label tinted in Electric Cyan (`#7CFFEA`). Idle icons rest in `#A8B0D4` at `65%` opacity.\n\n### Form Inputs & Toggles\n- **Glass Text Input:** Height `52px`, `16px` radius, filled with `rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05)`. Active focus transitions border to `#7CFFEA` with a matching `0 0 12px rgba(124, 255, 234, 0.25)` halo.\n- **Toggle Card:** Min-height `84px`, `20px` radius. Features a glass row background. The active switch state displays an Electric Cyan thumb track accented by a subtle Neon Magenta halo edge.",
